FTSE 100 Trades at Over 1-Week Low — The FTSE 100 traded within a narrow range of less than 0.5% in either direction for a 10th consecutive session, slipping to a more than one-week low as investors remained cautious amid uncertainty over a potential Middle East peace deal. The US and Iran appeared to harden their positions in negotiations over the Strait of Hormuz, despite Pakistan’s defense minister saying the two sides were “close to some sort of arrangement.” Meanwhile, markets looked ahead to key US inflation data, which could influence expectations for the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate path. Oil majors Shell and BP fell 0.3% and 0.4%, respectively, while AstraZeneca, GSK and Unilever also declined. Burberry, Tesco and JD Sports dropped around 1.7% to 2%. On the upside, aerospace and defense companies BAE Systems and Babcock gained around 1.5% each, supported by continued strength in the sector.

DAX Advances to Fresh Highs — The DAX 40 edged up to around 26,430 on Wednesday, marking a fresh high and extending its winning run to five sessions. Traders monitored more corporate earnings and eyed geopolitical developments ahead of the release of a key US inflation report. Gains were largely driven by technology and industrial stocks, outweighing losses in consumer cyclicals, telecommunications companies, and automakers. Siemens Energy and Rheinmetall performed strongly, rising 3.9% and 2.4%, respectively. Chipmaker Infineon Technologies and AI-related Hochtief followed, up around 1.6% each. TKMS jumped over 11% as investors welcomed solid results and an upgraded full-year revenue outlook from the naval shipbuilder. On the downside, TUI dropped nearly 2% after Europe's largest travel company missed Q3 operating profit expectations. Brenntag fell 1.6% despite reporting solid second-quarter performance, driven by higher chemical prices, and raised its full-year earnings outlook.

【海陽科技：持股5%以上股東減持至5%，減持計劃未實施完畢】海陽科技公告稱，持股5%以上股東福建贏石創業投資合夥企業（有限合夥）於2026年7月7日至8月12日透過集中競價方式減持公司股份923,100股，佔公司現有總股本的0.51%。本次權益變動後，其持股比例由5.51%降至5.00%，觸及5%刻度，減持計劃尚未實施完畢。本次減持不會導致公司控股股東、實際控制人變化，對公司治理結構及經營無重大影響。
【陽光諾和：控股股東協議轉讓5%股份過戶完成】陽光諾和公告稱，公司控股股東、實際控制人利虔於2026年7月15日與寶雋錢塘6號基金簽署《股份轉讓協議》，擬轉讓560萬股（佔總股本5%），轉讓價41.56元/股，總價2.33億元。8月12日取得過戶登記確認書，過戶日期為8月11日。過戶後，利虔持股降至22.59%，寶雋錢塘6號基金持股5%。受讓方承諾12個月內不減持，本次轉讓不影響控股權。

【天和磁材：特定股東減持164.83萬股 未完成減持計劃】天和磁材公告稱，股東南通元龍創業投資合夥企業（有限合夥）原計劃合計減持不超792.84萬股，即不超公司股份總數的3%。2026年5月14日至8月11日，南通元龍透過集中競價方式減持164.83萬股，減持比例0.62%，減持總金額6355.40萬元，減持價格區間為37.16 - 41.97元/股，未完成減持計劃，目前仍持股905.499萬股，佔比3.43%。

【美媒：泰國計劃就關稅問題向特朗普政府發出警告】“泰國計劃就關稅問題向特朗普政府發出警告。”彭博社11日爆出這一訊息，引起俄羅斯塔斯社、新加坡《海峽時報》等多家媒體關注。彭博社提到，美國此前決定對多個經濟體加徵關稅，泰國正尋求改善與美國之間的貿易條件。雙方之間的互惠貿易談判將於本月晚些時候重啟。報道稱，據知情人士透露，泰國計劃警告特朗普政府，美國加徵高額關稅可能迫使泰方縮減包括“金色眼鏡蛇”演習在內的軍事合作。訊息爆出，泰國政府計劃將這一立場納入一份提案中，雖然該條款措辭較為寬泛，但如果提高關稅給泰國造成重大經濟損失，泰方可能會重新考慮是否要參與聯合軍事活動。彭博社稱，這項提案標誌著泰國一種“罕見”的嘗試——將其與華盛頓之間長達數十年的安全夥伴關係作為籌碼。泰國國防部發言人對此表示，自己無法核實或確認該提案，“如果說有什麼進展的話，談判更有可能側重於加強合作”。報道補充稱，五角大樓與泰國商務部尚未回覆置評請求。（環球網）

【花旗：騰訊音樂整合喜馬拉雅對短期增長構成壓力，目標價降至11.4美元】花旗發表研報指，騰訊音樂第二季業績表現略勝預期，但核心音樂相關會員服務收入持續受壓及廣告收入增長放緩，認為第三季及全年展望轉弱。該行指，整合喜馬拉雅對毛利率有正面作用，但在成本最佳化及整合協同效應全面體現前，短期營運開支增加導致營運去槓桿，純利增長放緩，相信整合過程將對集團短期增長構成壓力。該行將騰訊音樂美股目標價由13美元下調至11.4美元，維持“買入”評級。

【湖北文旅集團與湖北廣電網路全面深化全省屬地合作】據湖北廣電資訊訊息，8月11日，湖北文旅集團與湖北廣電網路公司召開“文旅+廣電”業務融合對接會。雙方圍繞廣電網路資源與文旅業務場景深度融合進行精準對接，推動合作事項在全省落地落實。雙方表示，將以此次對接會為新起點，進一步強化跨領域協同聯動，建立日常溝通協調機制，全力保障各類合作專案高效落地、早見成效，共同開創全省“文旅+廣電”深度融合發展的新局面。

French Stocks Extend Losses — The CAC 40 fell 0.3% to 8,692.7 on Wednesday, extending losses from the previous session as investors remained cautious amid mounting uncertainty over the swift reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. Concerns about supply disruptions lingered despite comments from Pakistan’s defense minister that the US and Iran were “close to some sort of arrangement” regarding the strategic waterway, while reports also pointed to meaningful progress in talks between Tehran and Oman. Luxury stocks weighed heavily on the index, with LVMH falling 1.8%, Hermès losing 1.6%, and Kering dropping 2.4%. The sector remained under pressure as a prolonged slowdown in global luxury demand complicated succession planning at Armani Group, where the proposed sale of an initial 15% stake could reportedly be pushed back beyond March 2027. In contrast, STMicroelectronics added 0.6%, benefiting from strength across global tech markets.

【智明達：簽署轉讓銘科思微電子部分股權協議】智明達公告稱，公司近日與仁壽創新產業投資基金中心、成都銘思精創企業管理中心簽署《股權轉讓協議》，將所持成都銘科思微電子技術有限責任公司1100萬元註冊資本對應的股權，以每1元註冊資本5.5元（含稅）的價格轉讓。受讓方分兩次支付交易對價，第一筆分別為2750萬元、275萬元，第二筆相同。轉讓方收到首筆款項後20個工作日內完成工商變更登記。本次轉讓尚需辦理支付及登記手續，存在不確定性。

【東吳證券：維持宇通客車“買入”評級，全年高股息屬性仍具配置價值】東吳證券研報指出，宇通客車出口與產品結構改善，主業向好發展。2026H1公司實現歸母淨利潤18.67億元，同比-3.52%；2026Q2歸母淨利潤12.08億元，同比+2.4%。Q2公司出口客車約0.42萬輛、同比約+6%，出口新能源超0.12萬輛、同比約+55%，高價值出口與新能源佔比提升帶動單車收入改善，2026Q2單車收入約86.8萬元，同比+10%。公司預計下半年國內需求降幅有望收窄，行業出口增長勢頭仍將延續。認為非洲城市化與歐洲電動化仍是海外主增量，卡達KD工廠等本地化產能開啟中長期空間。公司中報未提出中期分紅預案，但公司歷史上分紅意願強、現金流與資本開支節奏匹配度高，全年高股息屬性仍具配置價值。維持“買入”評級。

【宗申動力：籌劃重大資產置換暨關聯交易仍在推進中】宗申動力公告稱，公司擬將摩托車發動機業務相關資產與負債（以重慶宗申發動機製造有限公司股權為核心），與隆鑫通用持有的通用機械業務相關資產與負債（以重慶新隆鑫機電有限公司股權為核心）置換，差額以現金補足。隆鑫通用為公司實控人控制的公司，本次交易構成關聯交易，預計構成重大資產重組，不會導致控股權變更。目前，交易仍處籌劃階段，具體要素未確定，雙方未籤協議，方案需進一步論證、協商及履行審批程式。
倫敦證券交易所集團（LSEG）資料顯示，法國日前基準電力價格上漲7.6%，至149歐元/兆瓦時。
【*ST聯翔：控股股東協議轉讓5%股份事項終止】*ST聯翔公告稱，2026年3月20日，控股股東卜曉華擬以20.36元/股的價格，向金美含協議轉讓518.14萬股（佔總股本5%），總價款1.05億元。8月11日，因受讓方未按時足額支付價款，雙方簽署《股份轉讓終止協議》，原協議終止。轉讓方將無息退還預付款，本次終止不會影響公司控股權、財務及經營狀況，也不存在違規違約情形，原權益變動報告書作廢。

India 10Y Yield Steady on Oil, CPI — The yield on India’s 10-year G-Sec hovered around 6.78%, trading in a tight range as elevated oil prices restrained demand for government bonds ahead of key India and US inflation data. Brent crude rose 0.8% to $89.6 per barrel, as uncertainty over the Middle East conflict kept oil prices elevated and raised inflation concerns. Meanwhile, India’s July inflation data, due later Wednesday, is expected to show inflation rising to 4.50% from 4.38% in June, while a hotter-than-expected US reading could revive Fed rate-hike bets and put upward pressure on Indian yields by narrowing the yield premium over US bonds. However, expectations for further RBI rate hikes have eased since the central bank kept rates unchanged last week and lowered its inflation forecasts. Strong foreign inflows and ample liquidity have also supported bonds, with the RBI’s diaspora deposit scheme attracting over $36.7 billion as of July 17, while the daily average cash surplus exceeded INR 3 trillion in August.

European Stocks Lack Direction — Both the STOXX 50 and STOXX 600 hovered around the flatline near record levels on Wednesday, as traders refrained from making major bets ahead of the US CPI report, which is expected to provide fresh clues on price pressures and help shape expectations for the Fed's next steps. Rising oil prices also kept sentiment cautious. Meanwhile, the earnings season is drawing to a close, although several companies continued to report results. ABN AMRO surged more than 5% after beating market expectations across the board, while Vestas jumped more than 18% after reporting higher revenue. The tech sector was among the top performers, benefiting from a broader global tech rally after CoreWeave reported better-than-expected sales growth. ASML Holding rose 2%, Infineon Technologies gained 1.6%, Siemens Energy advanced 3.5%, and Rheinmetall climbed 1.3%. Luxury stocks, meanwhile, came under pressure, with LVMH falling 1.8%, Hermes declining 1.5%, and Kering dropping 2.9%.
市場訊息：日本首相高市早苗和伊朗總統佩澤希齊揚討論了緩和中東緊張局勢和霍爾木茲海峽通行等問題。

【大和：首予中國AI行業正面評級，首選阿里巴巴】大和發表報告，啟動覆蓋中國AI行業，予正面評級，並特別聚焦於基礎模型。隨著模型能力提升及智慧成本下降，行業正從模型基準測試競爭轉向大規模模型消費，商業化推進速度已超預期。該行基本情境估計中國AI程式設計總潛在市場規模至2030年將升至2640億元，複合年增長率266%，消費者AI總潛在市場規模將達1160億元，複合年增長率154%，而企業及多模態應用的長期機遇更為龐大。該行將阿里巴巴列為首選，維持“買入”評級，目標價175港元。

【三星、SK海力士最快本月底公佈股東回報 總額或超200萬億韓元】三星電子與SK海力士或將於本月底公佈歷史最大規模的股東回報方案。隨著人工智慧（AI）驅動的儲存晶片超級週期推動兩家公司的現金創造能力大幅提升，市場甚至開始討論，兩家公司包括特別分紅、回購並登出股票等在內的股東回報規模合計可能超過200萬億韓元。 據12日訊息，三星電子（005930）和SK海力士（000660）正在內部討論上述大規模股東回報方案。如果相關程式推進順利，最快可能於本月底公佈具體方案。金融投資業界甚至有分析認為，三星電子今年的股東回報規模可能超過100萬億韓元。
【美共和黨重金阻擊一“搖擺州”民主黨議員候選人】與美國參議院多數黨領袖、共和黨人約翰·圖恩有關的超級政治行動委員會“參議院領導力基金會”最新斥資600萬美元，自12日起在美國知名“搖擺州”密歇根州投放電視和數字競選廣告，阻擊該州民主黨推出的聯邦參議員候選人阿卜杜勒·賽義德。（新華社）
【京東方Ａ：董事郭川因工作需要辭職】京東方Ａ8月12日公告，公司收到董事郭川提交的書面辭職報告。因工作需要，郭川申請辭去公司董事及董事會專門委員會相關職務，辭職後將不再擔任公司及控股子公司任何職務。郭川的原定任期至公司第十一屆董事會任期屆滿日止。根據相關規定，郭川的辭職申請自公司收到辭職報告之日生效。
加拿大皇家銀行將斯特蘭蒂斯目標價從7歐元下調至5歐元。

俄羅斯總統普京：若西方國家扣押俄羅斯商船，俄方將作出對等回應。
俄羅斯總統普京：俄羅斯注意到多個國家的當局正試圖限制俄羅斯船隻的航行。
【容大感光：劉長青宣告符合獨立董事任職資格】容大感光公告稱，獨立董事候選人劉長青宣告，其與公司不存在影響獨立性的關係，符合相關法規及深交所業務規則對獨立董事任職資格及獨立性的要求。劉長青承諾宣告及材料真實準確完整，任職期間將遵守規定、勤勉盡責，若不符任職資格將及時報告並辭職。
【江蘇有線：副總經理李冠軍因工作調整離任】江蘇有線公告稱，公司董事會近日收到副總經理李冠軍書面辭呈，其因工作調整，於2026年8月11日辭去該職務，原定任期至2027年6月26日。辭呈自送達董事會之日起生效，李冠軍已做好交接，辭任不會對公司日常經營產生不利影響。其離任後將繼續在公司任專家，截至公告披露日，未持有公司股份，無未履行完畢的承諾事項。
【南極電商：重大訴訟涉案金額變更 一審正在審理中】南極電商公告稱，公司與上海新和兆、和兆品牌管理公司商標使用許可合同糾紛一案，公司向上海市青浦區人民法院申請變更原訴訟請求，金額從8169.07萬元變更為2.96億元（暫計）。此外，上海新和兆起訴公司所涉訴訟金額（變更後）為3.13億元（不含利息）。兩案均在一審審理中，對公司利潤影響存在不確定性。
【曲美家居：過去 12 個月與關聯人趙澤龍發生 32.44 萬元關聯交易】曲美家居公告稱，公司實際控制人、控股股東趙瑞海之子趙澤龍，過去 12 個月透過櫥窗帶貨等形式推廣公司產品，公司按抖音平臺規則向其支付服務費，累計關聯交易金額 32.44 萬元。交易定價遵循公平原則，價格公允。該關聯交易已獲獨立董事專門會議和董事會審議透過，對公司生產經營等不構成重大影響，不會影響公司獨立性和持續經營能力。
【海思科：創新藥HSK60002片獲藥物臨床試驗批准】海思科公告稱，公司近日收到國家藥監局下發的HSK60002片《藥物臨床試驗批准通知書》，同意開展臨床試驗。該藥品為公司自主研發的口服小分子製劑，擬用於炎症性疾病治療，臨床前研究顯示其在相關動物模型中藥效顯著、機制明確，有開發價值和轉化前景。創新藥研發風險高，公司將及時披露後續進展。
【中鼎股份等成立新能源科技公司 含電子專用材料研發業務】企查查APP顯示，近日，安徽中鼎碳芯新能源科技有限公司成立，法定代表人為蔣偉堅，註冊資本為3000萬元，經營範圍包含：新材料技術推廣服務；新材料技術研發；電子專用材料研發；電子專用材料製造；電池製造等。企查查股權穿透顯示，該公司由中鼎股份、合肥國科碳芯科技有限公司共同持股。
【京靈智康簽約落地合肥高新區】“合肥高新發布”微信公眾號訊息，近日，合肥京靈智康科技有限責任公司正式簽約落地高新區。該公司是靈心巧手在民生康復賽道的核心戰略載體，主要從事智慧仿生靈巧手的研發與生產。
【東風股份：2026年7月汽車銷量7509輛，新能源銷量3397輛】東風股份公告，2026年7月汽車合計產量8799輛，本年累計77704輛，累計同比增長10.18%；銷量7509輛，本年累計76694輛，累計同比減少1.15%。其中新能源汽車本月產量4771輛，銷量3397輛，本年累計銷量21999輛，累計同比增長97.69%。東風康明斯發動機本月銷量20355臺。
檔案顯示，越南石油天然氣集團正考慮啟動液化天然氣招標，計劃簽訂一份為期五年的採購合同，年採購量最高為45萬噸，交貨自明年1月起開始。
俄羅斯普京：北約正在滲透亞太地區，北極地區緊張局勢正在加劇.

【通策醫療：控股股東部分股票質押及解除質押】通策醫療公告稱，2026年8月12日，公司控股股東寶群實業質押1855.3451萬股，佔其所持股份12.24%，佔總股本4.15%，用於體系外醫療專案；解除質押1655.3451萬股，佔其所持股份10.92%，佔總股本3.70%。寶群實業累計質押10108.6672萬股，佔其所持股份66.68%，佔總股本22.60%。未來半年、一年到期質押股份分別為2462萬股、6023.8221萬股。寶群實業資信好，質押風險可控，不會影響公司控制權。
【春風動力：全資子公司收到美國關稅退稅 預計增利1.83億元】春風動力公告稱，公司美國全資子公司CFP近期陸續收到美國關稅退回款項，截至目前累計收到3860.79萬美元。按2026年8月12日匯率折算為人民幣2.62億元，考慮所得稅費用後預計影響2026年度淨利潤約1.83億元，佔最近一期經審計歸母淨利潤的10.95%，利潤影響主要在下半年。最終結果以審計確認後為準。
【靈康藥業：子公司產品注射用石杉鹼甲中選省際聯盟採購，採購週期2年】靈康藥業公告，公司全資子公司靈康製藥產品注射用石杉鹼甲（商品名：瑞立速）中選由河南省牽頭的34種藥品省際聯盟集中帶量採購，採購週期為2年，參與省份覆蓋全國多個省區市。本次中選有利於拓寬聯盟內公立醫院渠道，提升產品覆蓋率和銷售規模。
市場訊息：高市早苗與伊朗總統通電話。
【第一三共優赫得聯合帕妥珠單抗新適應症在中國獲批】8月12日，第一三共宣佈，優赫得®（注射用德曲妥珠單抗）新適應症在中國獲批，批准的適應症為：本品聯合帕妥珠單抗，適用於一線治療不可切除或轉移性HER2陽性成人乳腺癌患者。
【亨通光電等成立海洋科技公司】企查查APP顯示，近日，江蘇亨通盤達海洋科技有限公司成立，法定代表人為錢志康，註冊資本為2000萬元，經營範圍包含：海洋工程裝備製造；深海石油鑽探裝置製造；電線、電纜經營；海上風電相關裝備銷售等。企查查股權穿透顯示，該公司由亨通光電旗下江蘇亨通高壓海纜有限公司等共同持股。
【TCL Solar與印尼PT API簽約】據TCL中環訊息，近日，印尼本土能源龍頭PT Ares Perkasa Indonesia（簡稱“PT API”）代表團到訪中國，與TCL Solar正式簽署戰略合作諒解備忘錄（MOU）。雙方將聯動印尼國家級主權投資機構Danantara Indonesia組建三方聯合體，共同競標開發當地大型新能源專案。
【天山鋁業成立新能源公司】企查查APP顯示，近日，石河子市天鋁新能源有限公司成立，法定代表人為趙慶雲，註冊資本為5000萬元，經營範圍包含發電業務、輸電業務、供（配）電業務；光伏發電裝置租賃；太陽能發電技術服務等。企查查股權穿透顯示，該公司由天山鋁業間接全資持股。
【恆順醋業：聘任巫明傑為公司財務總監】恆順醋業公告稱，公司第九屆董事會第十五次會議於2026年8月11日召開，以9票同意、0票反對、0票棄權審議透過聘任巫明傑為財務總監，任期至第九屆董事會屆滿。巫明傑1990年11月出生，歷任鎮江交通產業集團財務管理部相關職務，現任多家公司董事，未持有公司股份，與主要股東等無關聯關係，無違規受限情況。
【拱東醫療：全資子公司收到美關稅退稅 預計增利638.56萬元】拱東醫療公告稱，全資子公司TPI近期收到美國關稅退回款項，累計收到940,689.10美元（含關稅900,986.20美元、利息39,702.90美元）。按2026年8月12日匯率折算，摺合人民幣約638.56萬元，佔最近一期經審計歸母淨利潤的12.40%。退回款項擬計入2026年當期損益，最終會計處理及影響金額以審計結果為準。
瑞安航空與谷歌雲宣佈建立為期五年的資料和人工智慧合作伙伴關係。

【國晟科技：下屬公司涉3763.64萬元訴訟 結果尚不確定】國晟科技公告稱，公司四級控股子公司山東元隆世安新能源有限公司近日收到傳票，被深圳光遠智慧裝備股份有限公司起訴。原告要求被告一支付已交付6臺裝置剩餘貨款1002.6萬元及違約金等，被告二承擔連帶責任。截至公告日，公司及下屬全資、控股子公司連續12個月內累計訴訟、仲裁新增涉案金額3763.64萬元，佔最近一期經審計淨資產的12.11%。因案件未開庭，最終結果及對公司利潤影響均不確定。

【艾迪藥業：1.60億元完成收購控股子公司少數股東22.23%股權】艾迪藥業公告稱，公司此前擬以1.30億元收購華泰國信、道興創投及姚繁狄持有的南大藥業合計22.2324%股權。公司已按約定向華泰國信、道興創投分別支付尾款4594.29萬元、23.10萬元，向姚繁狄支付全部價款1462.50萬元，共計1.60億元。近日交易事項交割完成，姚繁狄將其持有的南大藥業2.50%股權過戶至公司名下，南大藥業董事會人數由10人變更為9人，並完成工商變更登記。

【蘋果商店現山寨版政務APP 官方回應】近日，福建政務服務APP統一平臺（簡稱“閩政通APP”）在蘋果應用商店被“假冒”一事在網上引發關注。新黃河記者查詢發現，該假冒的APP名為“閩證通”，其在下載頁依舊標註自己是“政務便民服務應用”。此外，記者目前僅在蘋果應用商店搜尋到該APP，部分安卓平臺的手機品牌應用商店均未搜尋到此應用。對此，閩政通APP官方回應稱，目前公司已把相關情況上報，相關部門正在協調處理，同時市民也可以直接在蘋果應用商店對APP進行舉報。（新黃河）
【超純應材：公司與比亞迪已建立合作關係】超純應材8月12日在互動平臺稱，公司與比亞迪已建立合作關係，相關業務正常推進。

The FTSE 100 Index Opens 0.10% Lower — The FTSE 100 Index is falling 11 points. Losses were driven by Burberry (-2.22%), Tesco (-2.04%) and JD Sports Fashion (-1.76%). Biggest rises came from Spirax-Sarco Engineering (2.21%), Rolls-Royce (1.28%) and BAE Systems (1.17%).
【江西省鷹潭市人民政府副市長陳敏接受審查調查】據江西省紀委監委訊息：江西省鷹潭市人民政府黨組成員、副市長陳敏涉嫌嚴重違紀違法，主動向組織交代問題，目前正接受江西省紀委監委紀律審查和監察調查。

The DAX Index Opens 0.11% Higher — The DAX Index is gaining 29 points or 0.11 percent on Wednesday. Leading the gains are Siemens Energy (3.49%), Infineon (1.46%) and Rheinmetall (0.94%). Top losers are Adidas (-2.33%), Porsche Automobil (-1.68%) and E.ON (-1.37%).
【美聯儲柯林斯：戰爭加劇通脹擠壓低收入群體 9月加息或箭在弦上】美聯儲高階官員最新表示，美伊戰爭加劇了美國人的生活成本壓力，美國低收入群體正難以維持收支平衡。波士頓聯儲主席蘇珊·柯林斯週二（8月11日）表示，美國東北部的企業和家庭正因持續超過央行2%目標的通脹而承受擠壓，這一狀況已持續五年多。該官員還警告稱，為抑制通脹，聯儲可能需要提高利率。
【浙江嘉興海鹽縣一公司廠房發生火情，人員已安全疏散】海鹽縣人民政府西塘橋街道辦事處通報：8月12日12時46分許，海鹽縣西塘橋街道杭州灣大道浙江協和首信鋼業有限公司3號廠房屋頂光伏板發生火情。縣消防、應急等部門第一時間趕赴現場開展應急處置。目前人員已安全疏散，無傷亡情況，火勢已基本控制，起火原因正在進一步調查中。
【8月12日滬深兩市漲停分析】創業板指低開高走漲1.49%，房地產、消費股集體走強。百花醫藥7連板，秦安股份4連板，一圖看懂>>

The CAC 40 Index Opens 0.20% Lower — The CAC 40 Index is losing 17 points. Losses were led by Kering (-2.93%), Essilor (-2.53%) and Capgemini (-2.47%). Offsetting the fall, top gainers were Legrand (1.21%), Thales (0.75%) and Safran (0.66%).
【上海剛剛釋出黃浦江高潮位黃色預警】上海市水文總站15時釋出黃浦江高潮位黃色預警訊號：預計13日01時黃浦江蘇州河口最高潮位達到5.05米左右。市防汛指揮部要求各級防汛機構、沿江沿河各單位檢查落實防範措施。

【三星在半導體研發中引入Claude模型，耗時一月的設計驗證縮短至兩天】8月12日，據報道，三星電子已確認引入Anthropic的大語言模型Claude，並大幅縮短了部分半導體設計與驗證的週期。在向軟體開發人員優先開放Claude的AI程式設計工具Claude Code僅約三個月後，報道稱開發一線便展現出了顯著的效率提升。在客戶定製SoC的驗證工作中，原本預計耗時一個月以上的任務，僅用時兩天就完成。內部評估顯示，工作效率提升了約15倍。
【北京釋出2026年第十輪擬供商品住宅用地清單】8月12日，北京市規劃和自然資源委員會網站釋出了2026年第十輪擬供應商品住宅用地清單，涉及豐臺區嶽各莊地塊，土地面積約6.61公頃，建築規模14.15萬平方米，擬於近期供應。
中國地震臺網正式測定：08月12日15時14分在吉爾吉斯斯坦（北緯42.02度，東經75.45度）發生5.2級地震，震源深度10千米。
一名高階政府顧問表示，野火和熱浪正對希臘及地中海地區構成中長期財政風險。

【華源證券：7月理財規模季節性大幅增長1.75萬億元 理財存續規模35.4萬億創歷史新高】7月理財規模季節性大幅增長。據華源證券測算，2026年7月末，理財規模合計35.4萬億元，較上月末增加1.75萬億元，理財存續規模創歷史新高。2021年-2025年的7月份理財規模平均增加1.8萬億，今年7月理財規模增長符合季節性規律。機構表示，7月因股市調整，理財投資的二級債基收益率回落，部分理財產品淨值出現回撤，可能影響了理財規模增長，使得理財規模未能超季節性增長。7月，理財公司固收類理財及純固收理財當月平均年化收益率均較上月回落，分別為0.56%和1.51%。

【中泰證券：維持鵬鼎控股“買入”評級，AI業務進展順利】中泰證券研報指出，鵬鼎控股26H1業績符合預期，AI業務進展順利。26H1實現營收172.17億元，yoy+5.14%，歸母淨利潤12.84億元，yoy+4.11%。上半年AI業務高增，匯兌損失對利潤產生負面影響。重研發持續開拓新產品，持續擴產進一步佈局AI算力及光模組賽道。2026年5月，公司在深圳競得新的產業用地，並已透過董事會擬投資人民幣100億元新建深圳第三園區，建設人工智慧高階類載板及柔性電路板智造基地專案，持續擴產為未來增長奠定基礎。考慮今年消費電子承壓但後續公司AI領域的優勢及產能儲備，調整公司2026/2027/2028年歸母淨利潤為53.95/87.74/127.45億元，（此前預計2026/2027/2028年歸母淨利潤為56.18/81.73/109.66億元），按照2026/8/11收盤價PE為41.5/25.5/17.6倍，維持“買入”評級。
維斯塔斯股價漲幅進一步擴大，目前累計上漲16%，有望創下2014年11月以來最大單日漲幅。

【7月深圳新房銷售同比漲超30% 限購放鬆後外地客翻倍增長 業內：看好金九銀十市場行情】7月深圳樓市淡季不淡。資料顯示，7月全市新建商品住宅成交2664套，同比上漲32.5%。記者實地走訪深圳多個在售新盤，樓盤工作人員向記者表示，自4·29核心區限購放開後，異地客群大量湧入，外地購房客戶佔比從往年不足10%，攀升至20%以上且持續增長，同時，公寓樓盤也接近售罄狀態。還有專案開盤就賣了四成，三個半月銷售近120套住宅。業內人士表示，市場普遍看好即將到來的金九銀十傳統銷售旺季。（第一財經）
【鄭州市氣象臺繼續釋出暴雨橙色預警訊號】鄭州市氣象臺2026年8月12日15時9分繼續釋出暴雨橙色預警訊號：目前，經開區局地累計雨量已達245毫米，航空港區局地累計降雨量已達333毫米。預計未來3小時降水仍將持續，鄭州市主城區、上街區、航空港區等全部鄉鎮和街道有20-40毫米的降水，局地最大累計降水量可達360毫米以上，請注意防範強降雨引發的山洪、地質災害和城市內澇等次生災害。
港股應用軟體板塊震盪走弱，金蝶國際(00268.HK)跌超8%，金山軟體(03888.HK)、塗鴉智慧(02391.HK)等跟跌。

【百誠醫藥旗下百倫檢測中標昆藥集團採購專案】據百誠醫藥8月12日訊息，近日，百誠醫藥旗下全資子公司杭州百倫檢測技術有限公司（簡稱“百倫檢測”）中標華潤醫藥集團有限公司旗下昆藥集團股份有限公司（簡稱“昆藥集團”）的“基因毒性雜質評估單價框架採購專案”。本次合作聚焦於藥品基因毒性雜質的評估服務。定量結構—活性關係作為國際通用的計算毒理學技術，能夠依託化合物分子結構快速預判其潛在致突變性與毒性風險。在此次合作中，百倫檢測將嚴格對標ICHM7、NMPA、FDA及EMA等國內外主流藥監指導原則，為昆藥集團提供涵蓋工藝雜質、降解雜質與工藝殘留的前置化致突變風險智慧預測與分級判定，協助企業科學制定雜質控制限度。
【烏克蘭首都基輔市響起爆炸聲】當地時間12日，烏克蘭首都基輔市響起爆炸聲，此前基輔拉響了防空警報。（央視新聞）

【中國歐盟商會代表團拜會中共中央對外聯絡部副部長馬輝】8月11日，中國歐盟商會主席彥辭（Jens Eskelund）率領商會執行委員會代表團，與中共中央對外聯絡部副部長馬輝舉行閉門會談。雙方就中歐關係以及歐洲企業在華面臨的挑戰交換了意見。彥辭強調，開展常態化對話、相互理解雙方合理關切，對於尋求可行解決方案具有重要意義。商會代表團還提出經濟安全、內卷、本土化、低碳發展以及國產產品標準等相關議題，從而更好地踐行“立足中國，服務世界”。馬輝表示，與中國歐盟商會開展建設性交流十分必要，有助於推動雙邊合作，在國家安全與發展之間尋求平衡。
蒙古國將政策利率上調0.5個百分點至12.5%。

Oil Extends Gains on Hormuz Uncertainty — Crude oil climbed toward $84 per barrel on Wednesday, advancing for a fifth straight session as investors weighed conflicting signals surrounding a potential agreement between the US and Iran. President Donald Trump said the US had “total control over the Strait of Hormuz” as negotiations over the key waterway remain deadlocked. The increasingly confrontational rhetoric raised further doubts about the prospects of an immediate agreement to reopen the critical shipping route. Meanwhile, Pakistan’s defense minister said Washington and Tehran are “close to some sort of arrangement” regarding the Strait of Hormuz, while reports indicated that talks between Iran and Oman have reached an advanced stage. UK Natural Gas Prices Rebound — UK natural gas prices rose above 148 pence a therm on Wednesday, rebounding from the previous session’s losses, as doubts grew over the likelihood of an agreement to resume energy flows through the Strait of Hormuz. Supply concerns persisted despite Pakistan’s defense minister saying that the US and Iran were “close to some sort of arrangement” over the waterway, while negotiations between Tehran and Oman were also reportedly making significant progress. Both Washington and Tehran had taken a firmer stance, clouding the outlook for a swift reopening of the strait. The ongoing disruption to shipping has severely constrained LNG shipments, with cargoes from major exporter Qatar significantly delayed. Analysts expect European gas prices to maintain a firm floor until storage levels show clearer signs of building ahead of the heating season. Hot weather across Europe is also boosting electricity demand for cooling, adding further pressure to the market.

US Inflation Rate Expected to Slow for 2nd Month — The annual inflation rate in the US is expected to slow for a second consecutive month to 3.4% in July 2026, from 3.5% in June, easing further from the 2023 high of 4.2% reached in May. On a monthly basis, the CPI is forecast to rise 0.1%, rebounding from a 0.4% decline in June, which marked the first monthly drop since May 2020. Gasoline prices are expected to have fallen nearly 3%, while airfares and jet fuel prices are also likely to have declined. New and used car prices, meanwhile, could see a slight uptick. Core consumer prices are expected to rise 0.2%, following a flat reading in June, while the annual core inflation rate is seen easing to 2.5% from 2.6% in the previous month. That would mark the smallest annual increase since February. Overall, the CPI report is likely to point to a further cooling in energy-related price pressures that intensified in the months immediately following the start of the US war with Iran.

【美國木材廠爆炸致死3人 或因消防員處置不當】美國全國職業安全和衛生研究所日前釋出調查報告說，美國東北部緬因州一木材廠5月發生的爆炸事故可能與消防人員滅火措施不當有關。該事故造成3人死亡、至少13人受傷。據美國方面11日訊息，位於緬因州沃爾多縣西爾斯蒙特鎮的羅賓斯木材廠一處筒倉5月15日起火，消防員噴水滅火時發生爆炸。根據調查，涉事筒倉為限氧型密閉結構，起火後可燃氣體會在其內部積聚壓力。噴水或使氧氣進入筒倉，攪動內部粉塵，形成爆炸性混合物。報告指出，消防員並不清楚筒倉結構特性，但該設施生產商和消防部門的滅火指南均禁止向此類筒倉噴射水或泡沫滅火劑。緬因州消防局長辦公室5月底認定該事故屬意外。（央視新聞）

TAIEX Hits Near 4-Week High, Ends 0.9% Higher — The TAIEX, Taiwan’s benchmark stock index, advanced 397 points, or 0.9%, to close at 45,518 on Wednesday, extending gains for the third consecutive session, mainly buoyed by electronic technology, technology services, and producer manufacturing. The broader index lingered at its highest level since July 16, as traders capitalized on the upward momentum in the tech sector. Electronic technology stocks gained 1.1%, with TSMC, the world's largest contract chipmaker and a company that accounts for more than 40% of the market's total value, climbing 0.8% after a 0.6% gain a day earlier. Hon Hai Precision Industry surged 2.5%, while Unimicron rose 0.8%. Meanwhile, Accton Technology Corp. and Quanta Computer jumped 3.8% and 3.2%, respectively. However, a decline on Wall Street overnight limited gains, as rising oil prices raised questions about the Fed's monetary policy at its upcoming meeting, while traders awaited the release of US inflation data later today.

【Goldman Sachs: software stocks begin to realize AI gains】Goldman Sachs TMT trader Peter Callahan says the post-earnings AI narrative within software is shifting: fears that generative AI would erode traditional software moats are yielding to a view that data infrastructure and developer-tools vendors are moving from an AI headwind to a tailwind. Cloudflare, Palantir, Datadog, Twilio and Atlassian have drawn greater investor attention; traditional SaaS application vendors still need to prove clear AI benefit. Callahan notes AI commercialisation is extending from model training into inference, agents and automation. Cloudflare disclosed non‑human traffic now exceeds human traffic and said machine‑generated requests should grow rapidly if current trends persist. That suggests AI can be demand‑accretive for platforms that carry data, APIs, network traffic, security and developer tools, since more agents and higher call frequency can create direct revenue opportunities. Software is therefore bifurcating: AI upside increasingly depends on whether a company sits at the application layer or the infrastructure layer and on its ability to monetise AI traffic.

【美能源部長：海灣石油出口已接近戰前水平】作為全球能源運輸的咽喉要道，霍爾木茲海峽的通行過去幾個月因美伊衝突受到嚴重擾亂，供需失衡導致能源價格飆升。然而，根據美國能源部長克里斯·賴特（Chris Wright）的最新說法，波斯灣地區的石油出口量已恢復到戰前水平，僅霍爾木茲海峽的原油出口量就達到了七天平均每天近900萬桶。如果這些數字準確的話，就表明儘管伊朗設定了障礙，美國仍然能夠維持透過海峽的大宗石油貿易，但賴特的估計遠遠超過了任何其他主要油輪運輸追蹤機構或能源分析師的估計。“得益於美國軍方和海灣盟友的協調努力，目前霍爾木茲海峽的石油七日日均輸油量已接近900萬桶，”賴特週二在社交媒體上發帖稱：“加上每天透過新升級的管道和出口設施輸送的500萬至700萬桶石油，目前該地區的石油總流量平均約為每天1500萬桶。”

ASX 200 Finishes in the Red — The ASX 200 fell 41 points, or 0.45%, to close at 9,209 on Wednesday, erasing the prior session’s modest gains as sharp losses in manufacturing, consumer non-durables, healthcare, and retail trade dragged the index to its weakest level in a week. Sentiment soured after the Reserve Bank of Australia held the cash rate steady at 4.35% on Tuesday but warned further tightening could follow if inflation lingers. Wall Street’s overnight slump added pressure, with escalating Middle East tensions and renewed attacks near key shipping routes stoking energy supply fears. Commonwealth Bank slipped 0.7% after reporting record annual cash earnings but flagged a sharp slowdown in mortgage demand post-tax changes. Rio Tinto eased 0.2% even as it secured government support to offset soaring energy costs. ASX tumbled 2.8% after a shareholder moved to file a Federal Court application against the bourse operator. Bucking the trend, AGL Energy surged 6.0% on stronger-than-expected 2027 earnings guidance.

Norway Consumer Pessimism Eases in Q3 — Norway’s adjusted consumer confidence indicator improved to -16.6 in Q3 2026, up from a downwardly revised -18.1 in Q2. The improvement came alongside less pessimistic views of the country’s economic outlook, with expectations for the national economy over the next year improving to -24.6 from -34.9 in Q2 and assessments of its performance over the past year rising to -37.1 from -47.1. Households were also more optimistic about their own finances, with expectations for personal finances over the next year turning slightly positive at 0.8 from -3.5, while assessments of their financial situation over the past year improved to -2.6 from -9.4. Sentiment toward major purchases also strengthened to -8.7 from -15.8, while households said they would prioritize repaying loans or saving and investing if their financial situation improved, with both responses reaching record highs since the survey began in 1992. Meanwhile, the unadjusted indicator rose to -14.4 from -22.1.

【毀滅性地震導致主要港口受阻 哥倫比亞咖啡出口基本停滯】一場毀滅性地震擾亂了哥倫比亞主要港口的運營，並導致主要高速公路沿線出現道路封鎖，據一家咖啡出口商協會負責人稱，該國的咖啡出口已基本暫停。Asoexport負責人Gustavo Gomez在接受採訪時表示，哥倫比亞主要咖啡出口港Buenaventura實際上無法進入，因為多條道路堵塞，尤其是Cali至Buenaventura高速公路沿線的隧道附近，這條高速公路是通往該國太平洋沿岸的主要路線。“咖啡相關作業目前已暫停。可能存在零星的作業，但目前咖啡出口作業已停止，”Gomez說，“目前尚無具體的官方通知說明道路何時能完全恢復通車。”

【大和：蘋果第三財季業績勝預期，目標價升至335美元】大和發表報告指，蘋果截至2026年6月底止第三財季業績勝預期，收入同比增長16%至1094億美元，每股盈利2.02美元，分別較市場預期高出7.66億美元及0.13美元；惟若扣除關稅退款約0.11美元，經調整每股盈利約1.91美元，僅較預期高出0.02美元。該行維持對其“跑贏大市”評級，目標價由325美元上調至335美元，相當於2027財年預測市盈率35倍。期內，iPhone收入同比增長22%至540億美元，Mac收入更大增29%至104億美元，服務收入亦增長12%至307億美元。管理層表示，iPhone、Mac及iPad需求強勁，公司未能獲得足夠的先進節點系統單晶片(SoC)以滿足需求，內部團隊更承認低估需求增長。不過，該行對2027財年前景轉趨審慎，因2026財年iPhone增長21%屬史無前例，參考過往超級週期後次年表現往往顯著回落；同時，9月新iPhone加價及儲存器成本上升，將對需求及盈利構成不確定性。

【OpenAI“1號商務員工”將離職 年初至今已有十餘名高管離任】美東時間週二，OpenAI高管布拉德·萊特卡普（Brad Lightcap）表示，他將離開公司並開啟新專案（start something new）。萊特卡普稱得上是OpenAI的元老級高管，也是阿爾特曼長期的“心腹”夥伴。早在OpenAI創立之前，萊特卡普就已經與阿爾特曼在風險投資公司Y Combinator共事。而在OpenAI 2015年創立後，他也一直擔任阿爾特曼的最親密顧問角色。值得一提的是，年初至今，OpenAI內部已有十餘名高管陸續離職。

【印度客機空中驟降傷20餘人 機長毒檢陽性】印度航空公司一架客機上週在空中高度驟降，造成20名乘客和4名機組人員受傷。印度媒體披露，涉事機長接受藥檢，結果顯示為大麻陽性。這架空中客車A320型客機4日從泰國普吉島飛往印度首都新德里，載有137名乘客和8名機組人員。在飛行途中，客機突然下降約90米。印度航空事故調查局11日釋出宣告說，正在調查這一事件，分析技術、醫學、人為因素等方面的證據。多家媒體援引訊息人士的話報道，機長在檢測中被查出大麻陽性，第二次毒檢依舊沒透過。（新華社）

【梁文鋒打新宇樹有望浮盈7億】繼參與戰略配售後，梁文鋒亦參與了宇樹科技的網下打新，其旗下量化機構寧波幻方量化155只產品獲得網下配售，其中包括幻方1000指數增強欣享1號私募證券投資基金、幻方滬深300普惠1號私募證券投資基金、幻方金選中性專享7號5期私募證券投資基金、幻方量化定製16號2期私募證券投資基金等產品，合計獲配19.5萬股，獲配金額約2940.77萬元。 此外，梁文鋒旗下另一家量化機構九章資產43只產品合計獲配6.32萬股，獲配金額約為952.97萬元。 梁文鋒透過旗下兩家主體合計198只私募產品獲得配售，合計獲配25.82萬股，合計配售金額約為3893.74萬元。

此前，梁文鋒已透過旗下大模型公司DeepSeek參與了宇樹科技的戰略配售，共計獲配93.34萬股，獲配金額約為1.41億元，鎖定期為36個月。加上此次網下打新配售的部分，梁文鋒透過DeepSeek、寧波幻方量化、浙江九章資產三家主體共計獲配119.16萬股，共計獲配約1.799億元。若宇樹科技上市首日市值突破3000億元，梁文鋒有望賺得浮盈約7.04億元。（《財經》雜誌）

【天津：鼓勵“機器人6S店”新型商業體建設】近日，天津市工業和資訊化局、市發展改革委、市科技局聯合印發《天津市智慧機器人產業創新發展行動方案（2026—2028年）》（以下簡稱《行動方案》）， 《行動方案》從金融賦能、人才培養、探索新型商業模式、用好支援政策、營造良好氛圍和安全監管六個方面強化保障措施。提出研究設立市級機器人產業專項基金，探索智慧機器人以租代售、委託租賃、槓桿租賃等現代化科技租賃服務；支援高校設立機器人交叉學科，共建實訓基地；鼓勵“機器人6S店”新型商業體建設，支援跨境電商營銷中心建設，打造智慧機器人出海總部基地。 天津市未來3年將依託世界智慧產業博覽會、天津機器人大會等平臺，組織開展專題交流、展演展示、前沿論壇等系列活動，擦亮天津機器人產業名片，強化區域產業輻射帶動作用。依託“117專案”片區建設“機器人小鎮”，構建“信創底座+製造中試+場景驗證”的特色產業優勢，打造“機器人自主可信可控產業生態”策源地和天津市智慧機器人先行區。依託天開高教科創園核心區建設“天津市智慧機器人應用展示體驗中心”，開展產品展示和資源對接活動。

China Car Sales Drop 0.3% in July — China's total vehicle sales fell 0.3% from a year earlier in July 2026, following a 3.2% decline in the previous month, according to data from the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers (CAAM). New energy vehicle (NEV) sales soared 23.7% year-on-year. For the first seven months of the year, vehicle sales dropped 3.7% year-on-year, compared with a 12.0% increase in the same period last year, while NEV sales climbed 9.6%. Last year, China's vehicle sales grew 9.4% year-on-year to a record high of 34.4 million units, accelerating from a 4.5% rise in 2024, while NEV sales surged 28.2%.

Romania Inflation Falls to One-Year Low — The annual inflation rate in Romania eased to 8.2% in July 2026 from 10.4% in June, remaining above market expectations of 7.9% but marking the lowest reading since July 2025. Inflation for non-food goods posted the sharpest slowdown, easing to 7.9% from 12.3% in June, largely due to a steep moderation in electricity price growth (2.9% vs 35.2%). Food inflation also slowed (5.0% vs 5.8%), reflecting softer price growth for vegetables, fruits, meat and meat products, milk and dairy products, and sugar. Meanwhile, service inflation was unchanged at 13.7%. On a monthly basis, consumer prices rose 0.58% in July, accelerating from 0.06% in June. Meanwhile, the HICP-based annual inflation rate eased to 8.2% from 9.2% in the previous month.

Sweden Household Spending Rebounds in June — Household spending in Sweden jumped 1.6% month-on-month in June 2026, rebounding from a revised 0.3% decline in the previous month. It marked the biggest increase since January, driven by a rebound in spending on personal care, social protection, and miscellaneous goods and services (5.9% vs -3.9% in May), transportation (5.4% vs -4.1%), recreation, sports, and culture (4.9% vs -1.5%), healthcare (3.9% vs -4.4%), furniture, household equipment, and routine home maintenance (3.8% vs -2.3%), and alcoholic beverages, tobacco, and drugs (1.6% vs -2.1%). Consumers also spent more on information and communication (5.3% vs 1.3%), as well as clothing and footwear (3.5% vs 0.4%). Meanwhile, expenditure on food and non-alcoholic beverages (0.5% vs 0.7%) and housing and utilities (0.4% vs 1.6%) slowed. On a yearly basis, household consumption rose 4.3%, following a revised 2.0% increase in May.

Palladium Holds Near 2-Month High — Palladium futures climbed toward $1,370 per ounce, remaining near more than two-month highs as reduced expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike and broader strength across precious metals supported demand. Markets price in about a 50% chance of a September Fed hike, down from 60% before last week’s weaker-than-expected US jobs report, with lower rates generally supporting non-yielding precious metals. Meanwhile, heightened geopolitical tensions supported precious metals, as attacks on shipping by the US and Yemen’s Iran-aligned Houthis and uncertainty over the Iran conflict kept safe-haven demand elevated. On the supply front, concerns over disruptions in South Africa and uncertainty over Russian exports continue to support prices, with extended maintenance at South African processing facilities reducing refined PGM output amid tight inventories. 【宇樹打新不只看運氣 黃牛收購價漲到410元/股】8月11日下午，宇樹科技打新結果陸續出爐，網上發行中籤率為0.0181%。這意味著，大約每5500個申購號碼裡，只有1個能中籤。這個機率，是長鑫科技中籤率的1/26。滬深打新規則下，股民幾乎只能拼運氣，但在數載難逢的“大肉籤”面前，部分打新者依然有提高中籤率的招數。例如，頂格申購，用滿12個配號；提早收集符合科創板資質、有滬市交易記錄的股票賬號，以量取勝。一位股民則加入了一個“共享打新群”：群主組織數百人一起申購，中籤後，群主按每次收益的20%—30%抽成，中籤者可以額外拿總收益的10%，剩下的則給每個參與申購的人按貢獻度平分，例如貢獻配號數量。“這樣就把小機率賺大錢、拼運氣的事，變成了更多人大機率賺小錢的生意。”部分網民在社交媒體上討論，宇樹科技上市後是否會破發。該股民透露，上市前，市場上已有黃牛在高價收宇樹科技的股票，8月10日報出的收購價已經漲到410元/股，比發行價150.80元/股高出170%。（經濟觀察報）

German July Inflation Confirmed at 3-Month High of 2.8% — Germany's annual inflation rate accelerated to 2.8% in July 2026, confirming preliminary estimates, up from 2.3% in June. It was the highest reading since April, driven by a sharp rise in energy inflation to 8.3% from 3.4%, as renewed Middle East tensions pushed oil prices higher. Meanwhile, services inflation eased to 2.9% from 3.1%, while food inflation remained unchanged at 0.4%. Core inflation, which excludes energy and unprocessed food, inched down to 2.4% from 2.5%. On a monthly basis, consumer prices rose 0.8% in July, rebounding from a 0.3% fall in June. The EU-harmonized inflation rate also accelerated to 2.8%, its highest level in three months and well above the European Central Bank's 2.0%

Japan Machine Tool Orders Surge 50.4% in July — Japan’s machine tool orders climbed by 50.4% year-on-year to JPY 193,102 million in July 2026, following a 52.8% surge in the previous month. The increase reflected robust demand across both domestic and overseas markets. Foreign orders rose 50.5% year-on-year to JPY 139,864 million, following a 56.0% increase in June, while domestic orders advanced 50.2% to JPY 53,238 million, after rising 45.5% in the previous month. On a monthly basis, total machine tool orders declined 5.1% in July, reversing sharply from a 15% increase in June. For the first seven months of the year, machine tool orders totaled JPY 1,248,243 million, up 37.8% from the corresponding period a year earlier, with foreign and domestic orders increasing 42.3% and 26.5%, respectively.

【South Korea unveils seven strategic tech projects covering nuclear, quantum, space and biotech】South Korea on Wednesday unveiled an ambitious seven-project technology strategy targeting nuclear energy, quantum computing, space, biotechnology and related advanced sectors to seek growth engines beyond semiconductors and AI. Key targets include commercial deployment of domestically developed small modular reactors by 2035, a lunar landing by 2030, a domestic 100‑qubit quantum computer by 2029, and commercial brain‑computer interface products by 2035. The plan is framed as a response to slowing long-term growth and intensifying global tech competition; the science minister said the government will support these seed projects over the next 10–20 years.

【中東局勢持續緊張，霍爾木茲海峽船隻通行量降至一週低點】航運資料顯示，週二霍爾木茲海峽被追蹤到的船舶通行數量降至一週最低水平。中東局勢持續緊張，船隻紛紛避開這條關鍵水道。Kpler資料顯示，週二進入海峽的船隻總數為八艘，低於10日均值約12艘，並創下8月5日以來的最低日統計數。其中僅有一艘煤炭運輸船駛離海峽，其餘船隻仍在透過途中。進入海峽的七艘船隻均選擇了伊朗側航線。倫敦證券交易所集團(LSEG)資料顯示，週二有11艘船隻透過海峽，低於前一天的14艘。在伊朗關閉該水道之前，通常每天約有130至140艘船隻透過該海峽。Kpler資料顯示，週二穿越紅海南端曼德海峽的船隻數量為30艘，高於10天平均值25艘。

NZX 50 Erases Gains at Finish, Down 0.9% — New Zealand's stocks fell 123 points, or 0.9%, to close at 13,738 on Wednesday, reversing a morning gain and declining for the second straight session, touching their lowest level since August 3, tracking a decline on Wall Street overnight amid higher oil prices due to uncertainty over the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. Caution also prevailed ahead of the US inflation data for clues about the Fed's monetary policy decision at its upcoming meeting. Investors assessed a statement from New Zealand's Prime Minister Christopher Luxon after he survived a second confidence vote. He has underlined the need to defeat the Labour-led opposition. Materials, industrials, and financials mainly weighed on the index, with the bottom performers being Mainfreight (-3.7%), Colonial Motor (-1.7%), Westpac Banking Corp. (-1.6%), ANZ Group (-1.3%), F&C Investment (-1.3%), and Infratil (-1.2%).
【香港特區政府醫務衛生局局長盧寵茂將訪海南深化醫療衛生交流合作】香港特區政府醫務衛生局局長盧寵茂今日（12日）率領代表團前往海南省進行為期3天的訪問，與當地醫療衛生官員會面，以持續深化香港與內地在醫療衛生方面的交流和合作，並會參觀海南博鰲樂城國際醫療旅遊先行區和當地醫藥企業，瞭解當地醫療服務和藥業的最新發展。（大灣區之聲）

Finland Current Account Surplus Largest on Record — Finland's current account surplus widened to EUR 2,830 million in June 2026 from EUR 1,282 million in the corresponding month of the previous year. This marked the largest current account surplus on record, largely as the goods account surplus climbed sharply to EUR 2,797 million in June from EUR 1,063 million a year earlier. At the same time, the primary income surplus increased to EUR 903 million from EUR 744 million in June 2025. Meanwhile, a wider deficit was recorded in the services account, which expanded to EUR 693 million from EUR 369 million, while the secondary income shortfall also rose to EUR 178 million from EUR 155 million.
【四川多地釋出高溫紅色、橙色預警】截至8月12日12時，四川遂寧、德陽、南充、綿陽、廣元等地已陸續釋出高溫橙色預警，最高氣溫將升至35℃以上。樂山、綿陽、德陽部分割槽縣更新預警訊號為高溫紅色預警，最高氣溫將升至37℃以上。
【利歐泵業中標中海油固定平臺多級離心式注水泵（BB5型）一級集採框架協議專案】利歐泵業公眾號訊息，近日，利歐泵業中標中海油2026—2027年度固定平臺多級離心式注水泵（BB5型）一級集採框架協議專案。專案集採範圍涵蓋多套多級離心式注水泵（BB5泵型），供貨裝置將廣泛服務於中國海油旗下渤海、東海、南海等海域的固定平臺、FPSO及其他浮式設施。
【劍橋科技等在嘉興成立股權投資合夥企業】企查查APP顯示，近日，嘉興滬江股權投資合夥企業（有限合夥）成立，經營範圍包含以私募基金從事股權投資、投資管理、資產管理等活動。企查查股權穿透顯示，該企業由劍橋科技等共同出資。

【印度散戶股票衍生品交易一年虧損96億美元 監管遏制措施成效有限】在截至3月的這一年中，印度散戶在股票期貨和期權交易中損失了9168.5億盧比（96億美元），說明監管部門為遏制個人投資者鉅額虧損採取的措施收效有限。印度官員Pankaj Chaudhary在書面回覆中表示，這段時期的虧損較上年的1.1萬億盧比略有減少，同期參與交易的投資者人數從980萬人降至不足800萬人。印度證券交易委員會此前發現，10名散戶衍生品交易者中有9人虧損，儘管監管機構此前曾多次警告，散戶與資金實力更雄厚、經驗更豐富的交易者競爭存在風險。然而，連續五年虧損凸顯了監管舉措的侷限性，以及勸阻個人投資者進行衍生品交易的挑戰。
【房地產板塊午後繼續走強 *ST中迪漲超8%】房地產板塊午後繼續走強，*ST中迪漲超8%，福星股份、新城控股等股上漲。

【AI程式設計初創公司Cognition據悉洽談新一輪融資 估值或達400億美元】據知情人士透露，Cognition AI正與投資者就新一輪融資進行早期磋商，該輪融資可能使這家人工智慧(AI)程式設計初創公司的估值提升50%以上，達到至少400億美元。知情人士稱，這家人工智慧企業在以260億美元估值籌得10億美元后不到三個月，潛在投資者便已開始圍攏過來，尋求入股這家業內最火熱賽道之一的領軍企業。知情人士還表示，該公司目前的年化收入執行率已接近10億美元，約為其上輪融資時披露數字的兩倍。其中一位知情人士稱，Cognition預計在本輪籌資將超過10億美元。但知情人士也提醒，公司仍可能決定不融資，或以不同條款尋求資金。

韓國政府稱目標在2030年前實現登月。

【2026中國算力大會將於9月11日至13日在河北省廊坊市舉行】2026中國算力大會將於9月11日至13日在河北省廊坊市舉行。大會首次舉辦“算力首創首發釋出會”，設定技術、產業兩大單元，將集中釋出一批首創首發算力軟硬體新品，重點展示國產算力晶片、智慧體、綠色算力等突破性成果；圍繞人工智慧、具身智慧、算電協同、太空算力、Token新經濟等前沿熱點，舉辦10餘場專題分論壇，深度探討算力從“建好”到“用好”的價值轉化路徑。(澎湃新聞)
【月之暗面增資至223萬】企查查APP顯示，近日，北京月之暗面科技股份有限公司發生工商變更，註冊資本由152.36萬元增至223.85萬元。企查查資訊顯示，該公司成立於2023年，經營範圍包含：人工智慧基礎軟體開發；人工智慧應用軟體開發等。
【民政部：上半年結婚登記327.5萬對】8月12日，民政部網站釋出《2026年2季度民政統計資料》，其中有關婚姻登記的資料是：結婚登記327.5萬對，離婚登記138.3萬對。
【百貨零售板塊短線拉昇，中興商業漲停】百貨零售板塊短線拉昇，中興商業漲停，寧波中百此前封板，百大集團、上海九百、永輝超市、銀座股份、東百集團等跟漲。
大韓航空：將透過合併吸收韓亞航空。
【星巴克中國回應“蜜雪冰城代工”傳聞：嚴重失實】8月12日，星巴克中國表示，對於網傳“星巴克紙杯吸管或由蜜雪冰城代工”、“更換咖啡豆供應商”等資訊，嚴重失實。“我們始終秉持可持續高質量發展理念，堅持開放姿態，和行業供應鏈夥伴們協同發展、互惠共生，致力於為顧客提供始終如一的高品質咖啡產品和星巴克服務體驗。”星巴克中國表示。（介面新聞）
【中國長安汽車與華為簽署戰略合作框架協議】中國長安汽車集團有限公司與華為技術有限公司8月11日在深圳簽署戰略合作框架協議。根據協議內容，雙方將在AI產品及場景、通用及汽車垂直大模型、數字化底座、算力和軟硬體等方面進一步探索合作方向和場景，在數字能源、國際化、數智化人才規劃和培養等方向加強合作。
【醫療器械板塊震盪反彈 寶萊特20cm漲停】午後醫療器械板塊震盪反彈，寶萊特20cm漲停，澳華內鏡漲超10%，鹿得醫療、康眾醫療、南衛股份、戴維醫療等跟漲。
【力拓鋁冶煉廠將獲得澳大利亞政府救助】知情人士透露，經過長時間談判，湯瑪戈（Tomago）鋁冶煉廠的多數股東力拓及其合作伙伴將獲得澳大利亞聯邦政府和新南威爾士州政府提供的財政支援，相關援助方案預計將於週四公佈，其中包括更多資金支援細節以及該冶煉廠未來運營計劃。相關工廠目前正面臨高昂能源成本壓力。

【中科海鈉： 鈉電牽引車登上工信部產品公告 鈉電技術加速商業化量產】中科海鈉8月12日官微訊息，近日，工業和資訊化部《道路機動車輛生產企業及產品》（第410批）正式釋出，由中科海鈉與一汽解放聯合研發的鈉離子電池換電牽引車名列其中。該車型是一汽解放旗下首款搭載鈉離子動力電池的重型卡車，也是中科海鈉在商用重卡領域取得的重要突破。此次與一汽解放合作的鈉電換電牽引車登上工信部公告，標誌著鈉離子電池技術已獲得主流車企的充分認可，正在加速進入商業化量產階段。2026年9月1日起，鈉離子電池開始免徵消費稅，鈉電重卡的成本優勢預期將進一步加強。
韓國政府：韓國將在核能、量子技術、航天與生物技術領域啟動7項“種子”專案，以培育未來增長引擎。

【白宮要求重新起訴“破壞倒影池”的前奧運選手】多名知情人士11日稱，白宮已要求司法部考慮對曾受控蓄意破壞美國首都華盛頓的重要地標——林肯紀念堂前倒影池的美國前奧運選手提起新指控。據美國方面訊息，白宮與司法部的討論屬於非正式的早期階段。司法部官員眼下正探尋，是否有可能對美國皮划艇運動員、前奧運選手戴維·赫恩提起輕罪指控。赫恩起初受輕罪指控，但檢方後續將罪名提升至重罪。不過，赫恩所涉案件的主審法官定於9月舉行聽證會，以裁定司法部是否不得再以同一犯罪行為起訴赫恩。
【首單民營企業倉儲物流公募REIT首次擴募獲受理】8月12日，嘉實京東倉儲基礎設施REIT首次擴募獲上交所受理。該REIT是國內首單民營企業倉儲物流公募REIT，此次擴募是上市以來的首次擴募，擬納入位於合肥和西安的兩處倉儲物流資產，合計建築面積約25萬平方米。
【醫藥商業板塊短線拉昇，瑞康醫藥漲停】醫藥商業板塊短線拉昇，瑞康醫藥漲停，第一醫藥、鷺燕醫藥、浙江震元、人民同泰、漱玉平民等紛紛走高。
滬深兩市成交額超1.5萬億元，較上日此時縮量1281億元。
【利比亞局勢動盪加劇 國內政治程序恐受阻】利比亞西部城市扎維亞的石油設施近日連遭無人機襲擊，東部城市班加西10日發生的汽車炸彈襲擊致“國民軍”情報負責人死亡。分析人士認為，利比亞局勢近來動盪加劇，陷於停滯的國內政治程序恐進一步受阻。（新華社）
【華為雲與滴普科技聯合釋出資料智慧解決方案】據華為雲訊息，8月12日，華為雲與滴普科技在北京聯合釋出資料智慧聯合解決方案。雙方將共同打造面向智慧製造、零售等行業的資料智慧聯合解決方案，幫助企業打通資料孤島，加速從資料治理到智慧體應用的一站式落地。
【颱風浪卡生成 預計未來對我國無影響】據中國天氣訊息，今年第17號颱風“浪卡”生成。“浪卡”名字來源：馬來西亞；名稱意義：又名菠蘿蜜果，黃色橢圓形狀，是馬來西亞非常流行的一種水果。預計“浪卡”未來對我國無影響。另外，今年第16號颱風“琵鷺”已減弱為熱帶低壓，將逐漸減弱消失。

【今年全球7月氣溫為有記錄以來第二高】當地時間8月11日，世界氣象組織發言人克萊爾·納利斯表示，西歐今年6月至7月經歷有記錄以來最熱時期，全球7月氣溫為有記錄以來第二高，全球海洋表面平均溫度則創同期最高紀錄。 此外，世界氣象組織氣候資訊主管約翰·肯尼迪表示，隨著全球氣候持續變暖，極端高溫天氣正變得更加頻繁、更加強烈，持續時間也更長。近幾個月的極端天氣是長期變暖與持續存在的高低氣壓交替模式共同作用的結果，目前沒有明確證據表明西歐今夏高溫與厄爾尼諾現象有關。隨著厄爾尼諾現象在太平洋地區持續發展，世界氣象組織預計全球氣溫將出現上升趨勢。

【美團王莆中：不開線下藥店，堅持做醫藥商家AI轉型小幫手】8月12日，美團核心本地商業CEO王莆中在西普會演講中指出，企業AI變革是業務設計、組織變革與技術應用的系統工程。美團希望做行業夥伴的AI小幫手，將AI經營專家、CatPaw能力及工作流改造方法論開放給醫藥行業。王莆中透露，目前美團首批AI經營專家已在漱玉平民、科赴等企業應用，並正式面向行業開放；此外，其全場景 AI Agent平臺CatPaw也將面向醫藥商家啟動試點。基於25萬家藥店與近500家藥企的合作伙伴生態，美團正打造醫藥零售AI時代的新型基礎設施。
【日本監管機構詢問銀行和保險公司有關國防融資的情況】據報道，日本金融廳已就政府認定具有戰略意義的國防產業的融資和投資情況，詢問了各大銀行和人壽保險公司。據知情人士透露，監管機構詢問了各銀行和保險公司對該行業的融資規模以及相關的內部政策。知情人士還表示，監管機構還詢問了各銀行和保險公司在向開發無人機等軍民兩用技術的初創企業提供資金方面是否存在任何限制。由於涉及私人事務，知情人士要求匿名。
【中際旭創A股成交額超200億元】8月12日下午，中際旭創A股成交額超200億元，現漲4.51%。
【英國首相伯納姆將主持召開關於野火和乾旱的緊急會議】據唐寧街釋出的一份宣告稱，英國首相安迪·伯納姆將於週三下午主持召開政府緊急委員會（COBR）會議，討論英國應對極端高溫、野火和乾旱的措施。
貝倫貝格將諾和諾德目標股價從50美元下調至47美元。
日本能源巨頭ENEOS表示，8月7日其麻里布煉油廠一套日加工能力為12.8萬桶的裝置發生非計劃停機。
【7月共有321傢俬募管理規模實現躍升】私募排排網資料顯示，7月共有321傢俬募管理人在規模上實現了跨越，佔到總量的4.43%。
【韓亞航空股東大會批准與大韓航空合併案】韓亞航空8月12日召開臨時股東大會，表決透過與大韓航空合併案。兩家公司將於今年12月17日正式合併為“大韓航空”。大韓航空2020年11月正式宣佈收購韓亞航空後，經過國內外競爭部門的企業合併審議，推進合併所需流程。韓亞航空表示，股東大會批准企業合併協議後，公司將據此切實推進各項跟進措施。

【印度航班驚險突降91米，機長“被查出吸食大麻”】一架印度航空上週在飛行途中突然下降約300英尺（約91米）高度，造成17人受傷。一名知情者透露，機長事後在毒品檢測中被查出吸食大麻。（參考訊息）

【韓國東南部乾旱嚴重 政府釋出國家消防動員令】由於韓國東南部地區今夏迎來罕見的持續高溫乾燥天氣，慶尚南道各地農業水庫近日開始乾涸，乾旱形勢日益嚴重。韓國政府為此釋出了國家消防動員令，自12日起向乾旱嚴重的慶尚南道提供200輛水罐車和400名消防人員，進行供水支援工作。據統計，截至12日，慶尚南道共有2121公頃農田遭受旱災；截至當天，在慶尚南道的18個市、郡中，密陽市、巨濟市和鹹安郡的農業用水處於“農業用水乾旱警戒”中最嚴重的“嚴重乾旱”階段。其中，乾旱最嚴重的密陽市農業用水蓄水率當天為25.7%，僅為常年標準的三分之一左右；而慶尚南道的平均蓄水率僅為33.3%，與常年相比下降了近一半。

【情境感知增持日本太陽誘電股份】據上月險些破產的人工智慧對沖基金情境感知(Situational Awareness)提交的多份檔案顯示，該公司於6月下旬購入日本伺服器元件製造商太陽誘電(Taiyo Yuden Co.)的股份，隨後增持至11.62%。週三，太陽誘電股價一度上漲6.7%，此前該基金向日本財務省通報稱，其持有該公司超過5%的股份，比金融監管機構規定的披露期限晚了一個多月。隨後幾個小時內提交的檔案顯示，該基金在7月中旬之前繼續增持股份。太陽誘電的代表未能立即就情境感知的持股情況置評。
【暑運以來深圳鐵路累計客流超2400萬人次】記者從深圳鐵路部門獲悉，7月1日至8月10日，深圳鐵路累計到發旅客2404.5萬人次，同比增加2.4萬人次，整體執行平穩有序。

【駐日美軍一架“魚鷹”運輸機緊急著陸】據日本共同社12日報道，駐日美軍一架“魚鷹”運輸機10日在栃木縣的日本陸上自衛隊宇都宮機場緊急著陸。美方稱之為避免事故發生的“預防性著陸”。 報道稱，這架“魚鷹”運輸機隸屬位於東京的駐日美軍橫田基地，已於11日離開宇都宮機場，目前暫未收到人員傷亡或財產損失報告。 報道還稱，橫田基地的“魚鷹”運輸機曾多次緊急著陸。今年2月和5月分別在日本巖手縣的花捲機場和神奈川縣的駐日美軍厚木基地發生過類似情況。 “魚鷹”運輸機事故多發。2023年11月，美軍一架“魚鷹”運輸機在鹿兒島縣屋久島附近海域墜毀，機上8人全部死亡。(新華社)
【央行連續第二天“零投放” 債市再迎“敲打” 30年國債上午再升0.6BP】債市收益率又迎“敲打”，繼昨日之後，央行今日再度執行公開市場操作“零投放”。上午，短期資金利率小幅抬升，10年國債在1.7%關口上午震盪，而此前強勢的30年國債則繼續承壓。業內分析認為，央行“零投放”實際影響有限，市場或正在重複歷史定價模式，但更多是情緒層面的修正。
【凱龍高科子公司重結晶碳化矽載體獲上汽大通輕客專案定點】據凱龍高科訊息，近日，凱龍高科控股子公司江蘇觀藍新材料重結晶碳化矽載體，獲取上汽大通輕客專案定點意向書，正式成為上汽大通輕客車型DPF載體定點開發供應商。
【國產武俠3A遊戲《影之刃零》開啟預購，國區標準版定價268元】8月12日，國產武俠3A遊戲《影之刃零》在Steam、PS5、Wegame等多平臺開啟預購，各平臺國區標準版定價268元，數字豪華版定價328元。正式發售日期為10月29日。

【美國出售與委內瑞拉有關的油輪 此前該油輪在公海被扣押】據買家稱，美國政府已出售一艘與委內瑞拉有關的油輪。該油輪於今年1月被美國海岸警衛隊扣押，此前該油輪在大西洋上經歷了一場驚心動魄的追逐。這艘影子船隊船隻由此獲准拆解報廢。這艘名為“貝拉1號”（Bella 1）的油輪曾於去年年底逃離美國在加勒比海的封鎖，並因頻繁更改船名、在船體上噴塗俄羅斯國旗以尋求庇護而遭到當局數週的追捕。最終，該船在冰島附近被扣押。買家環球營銷系統公司（Global Marketing Systems，簡稱GMS）的運營總監約格什·雷哈尼（Yogesh Rehani）表示，這艘油輪——現名為“時代號”（Era）——已於上週晚些時候獲准拆解，同時獲准拆解的還有另一艘被列入黑名單並被扣押的阿芙拉型油輪“利萊奧號”（Lileo）。此前，美國財政部已為這兩艘油輪頒發了拆解許可證。海事資料庫Equasis顯示，GMS位於美國的子公司目前是這兩艘油輪的所有者。

【州長：數百架無人機襲擊俄羅斯南部港口城市】克拉斯諾達爾邊疆區州長韋尼亞明·孔德拉季耶夫在社交媒體上表示，數百架烏克蘭無人機夜間襲擊了俄羅斯克拉斯諾達爾邊疆區，其中包括新羅西斯克、阿納帕、格連吉克和捷姆留克區。21棟居民樓和4家商鋪被無人機碎片擊中。他沒有提供更多關於受影響商鋪的資訊。注：新羅西斯克是俄羅斯最大的黑海石油出口樞紐，擁有俄羅斯石油管道運輸公司（Transneft）的輸油管道終端和CPC的海運碼頭；捷姆留克區包括塔曼港的糧食和石油碼頭。

【Omdia raises 2026 global semiconductor revenue growth forecast to 94.1% as AI demand surges】Omdia says sustained AI demand outstripping global supply has driven strong DRAM and NAND growth and prompted it to lift its 2026 global semiconductor revenue forecast to +94.1% YoY. Memory ICs are expected to account for over 50% of total semiconductor revenue in 2026. Omdia warns AI demand already exceeds current chip fabrication and packaging capacity; bottlenecks in HBM, advanced packaging and leading‑edge process capacity are expected to persist at least through 2027.

Sensex Falls for Second Day — India’s BSE Sensex fell about 0.3% to 77,957 on Wednesday, following the losses on the previous session as rising crude oil prices and caution ahead of domestic and US inflation data weighed on risk sentiment. Oil prices moved closer to $90 a barrel as concerns over tensions in the Middle East and uncertainty around the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz raised fears of higher energy costs. India’s annual inflation rate for July is also due later today, with forecasts pointing to a rise to 4.5% from 4.38%, which marked the highest rate since December 2024. Among stocks, Godrej Consumer Products was a major decliner. Its shares fell about 9.4% to their lowest level in more than three years after CEO Sudhir Sitapati unexpectedly resigned, just months after being reappointed, while Tata Group stocks also came under pressure following reports that Tata Sons Chairman N. Chandrasekaran may step down. Top losers included Dr. Agarwal’s (-5.7%), Tenneco Clean Air (-2.2%), and Manappuram (-1.7%)
【辰欣藥業等成立生物科技公司】企查查APP顯示，近日，濟寧辰啟生物科技有限公司成立，法定代表人為房慶賀，經營範圍包含食品網際網路銷售（僅銷售預包裝食品）；保健食品（預包裝）銷售；母嬰用品銷售；日用百貨銷售等。企查查股權穿透顯示，該公司由山東青蘅健康管理有限公司、辰欣藥業等共同持股。

【野村將開始在新加坡為富裕客戶提供實物黃金交易服務】野村控股的國際財富管理部門正在新加坡為其富裕客戶設立實物黃金交易和託管服務，此舉將有助於該國追求將自己打造為一個黃金樞紐的願景。野村週三釋出宣告稱，交易和託管服務將完全在新加坡開展，客戶可獲取大型金條以及公斤金條。這些大型金條重約400金衡盎司，是國際貿易結算的全球基準；公斤金條則是亞洲各個市場青睞的規格。“黃金已重新成為財富管理的一個基石，”野村國際財富管理投資產品及諮詢解決方案主管Akshay Prasad在宣告中表示。

【Omdia：AI需求激增 2026年半導體市場增幅上調至94.1%】Omdia發文稱，由於AI需求持續超過全球供應能力，推動DRAM和NAND市場實現強勁增長，Omdia將2026年全球半導體市場營收增長預測上調至同比增長94.1%。預計2026年儲存器晶片（Memory IC）收入將佔全球半導體總營收的50%以上。與此同時，AI需求已超出當前半導體產業的晶片製造和封裝能力，高頻寬記憶體（HBM）、先進封裝以及先進製程產能等關鍵環節的瓶頸預計至少將持續至2027年。

Malaysia Retail Sales Growth Slows in June — Retail sales in Malaysia rose 6.6% year-on-year in June 2026, slowing from a 7.2% increase in the previous month. Growth moderated in retail sales in non-specialised stores (7.0% vs 8.2% in May), as well as sales of other household equipment in specialised stores (3.2% vs 3.4%), automotive fuel in specialised stores (10.8% vs 12.8%), and food, beverages and tobacco in specialised stores (6.6% vs 7.2%). On the other hand, sales grew at a faster pace for other goods in specialised stores (7.0% vs 6.7%) and information and communication equipment in specialised stores (4.7% vs 3.5%). On a monthly basis, retail sales edged up 0.2%, easing from a 1.3% increase in the previous month.

【中國銅箔製造商龍電華鑫將美國首次公開募股（IPO）定價為每股22美元，預計將籌集約9500萬美元】中國龍電華鑫新能源科技公司週二將其美國首次公開募股（IPO）定價為每股22美元，這家銅箔製造商因此籌集了9430萬美元。該公司在此次IPO 中以20至22美元的發行區間上限 ，出售約430萬股美國存託憑證（ADS）。龍電華鑫（Londian Wason）的主要投資方包括韓國SK集團和未來資產。該公司股票將於週三在紐約證券交易所開始交易，股票程式碼為“FOIL”。坎托爾、華泰證券、中銀國際、美國老虎證券、福通證券和VC Brokerage擔任本次發行的承銷商。

Rupiah Extends Weakness Ahead of U.S. Inflation Data — The Indonesian rupiah extended its decline, hovering near IDR 17,870 per U.S. dollar on Wednesday, as the dollar index edged higher ahead of U.S. inflation data that could shape expectations for the Fed’s next policy move. Locally, weaker fundamentals weighed on sentiment, with retail sales and consumer mood staying subdued in July. Focus now turns to Bank Indonesia’s policy meeting next week, its first since Perry Warjiyo stepped down last month, with acting Governor Destry Damayanti nominated as sole candidate to lead the central bank. BI raised its policy rate by a total of 100bps in May and June to support the rupiah. Meanwhile, contained inflation should provide room for policy flexibility, with Indonesia's inflation rate hitting a three-month low of 2.88% in July, within the central bank's target band. The rupiah also found some support from hopes of policy continuity, as lawmakers are expected to approve Destry’s appointment smoothly, likely after Independence Day celebrations.

【伊朗稱天然氣日產能有望大幅回升 】伊朗石油部長穆赫辛·帕克內賈德8月11日表示，伊朗正在修復因戰事受損的天然氣生產設施，按計劃9月底前其日產能可回升9500萬立方米。 帕克內賈德稱，伊朗4座遇襲受損的天然氣處理設施重建工程正在迅速推進，重建承包商已經開工，預計將比計劃日程提前完工，完全恢復戰前產能。此前據路透社報道，自美以對伊朗發起軍事行動以來，伊朗天然氣日產量減少約2.3億立方米。

【Fed's Collins says she would support September hike if inflation remains high】Collins said rising living costs, amplified by the Iran war, are squeezing US low-income households and businesses and that energy costs in her region are particularly burdensome. She noted inflation has been above the Fed's 2% target for more than five years. A non-voting FOMC participant who backed holding rates in July, Collins described current policy as slightly restrictive and said she expects inflation to decline gradually but would support hiking rates as early as September if incoming data warrant tighter policy.

【永達股份：公司生產的產品暫未應用於人形機器人領域】永達股份在互動平臺表示，公司控股子公司金源裝備主營業務為高速過載齒輪鍛件的研發、生產和銷售，公司生產的產品暫未應用於人形機器人領域。

【波士頓聯儲銀行行長柯林斯對9月加息持開放態度】據英國《金融時報》週三報道，美國波士頓聯邦儲備銀行行長蘇珊·柯林斯表示，如果通脹率持續居高不下，她將支援9月加息；目前，隨著伊朗戰爭加劇了生活成本壓力，美國低收入群體正艱難地“勉強維持生計”。柯林斯在接受採訪時表示，如果資料顯示有必要，她願意支援最早在9月加息。“我確實認為未來幾個月的經濟形勢可能需要收緊貨幣政策，在這種情況下，我準備加息，”她說。這位波士頓聯邦儲備銀行行長目前並非美聯儲負責制定利率的聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）的投票委員。

【FT: U.S. vice president asked Ukraine to halt attacks on tankers using Russian ports; Kyiv complied】The Financial Times reports Ukrainian officials said Kyiv ceased intensive drone strikes on tankers using key Black Sea ports after a July 31 call in which U.S. vice president Vance asked President Zelenskiy to stop. Attacks had targeted tankers calling at the Caspian Pipeline Consortium (CPC) terminal that move Kazakh crude to Novorossiysk; U.S. officials were said to be alarmed that the strikes were destabilising oil markets and harming U.S. commercial interests. Ukrainian and other sources say Kyiv has agreed not to target CPC infrastructure or non‑Russian vessels provided those ships are not under Ukrainian sanctions and are not carrying Russian oil or other Russian cargo; officials say a mechanism was set up to enforce the arrangement and there have been no further attacks near the CPC terminal since the call.
【傳星巴克中國烘焙產品將由百勝中國代工 百勝中國暫無回應】8月12日午間訊息，據媒體報道，原山姆中國首席採購官張青已於近期加入博裕資本，擔任運營合夥人，並將參與博裕與星巴克中國合資公司的業務運營。報道稱，張青近期開始規劃星巴克供應鏈改造的相關戰略。其中，星巴克中國的烘焙部分將由百勝中國代工，紙杯、吸管、抹茶粉將由蜜雪冰城代工。對此訊息，截至發稿，百勝中國暫無官方回應。（新浪科技）

【Hong Kong midday: Hang Seng down 1.17%, tech names under pressure】Hang Seng extended yesterday's weakness, opening lower and sliding as much as 300 points intraday to a low of 25,323.33; it stood at 25,352.13 at the midday break, down 1.17%. Hang Seng Tech fell 1.17% to 4,767.88. Market turnover was HKD 117.01 bln. Sector movers: storage chips and optical-communications hardware outperformed; gold miners recovered; innovative-drug names stayed active; internet and tech names were broadly weak. Notable stock moves: Yangtze Optical Fibre & Cable (06869.HK) +7.86%, Zai Lab (09688.HK) +5.72%, GigaDevice Semiconductor (03986.HK) +5.61%, Chifeng Gold Mining (06693.HK) +3.14%; Tencent Music (01698.HK) -13.59% after results, Tencent Holdings (00700.HK) -2.93%.
【颱風“燦鴻”襲擊日本關東 多地交通受影響】11日，颱風“燦鴻”登陸日本茨城縣，給日本關東地區帶來強風等惡劣天氣。截至目前，“燦鴻”造成至少4人受傷。多地出現停電，交通受到影響。據日本氣象廳訊息，“燦鴻”11日晚在茨城縣南部登陸。這是自1951年日本開始進行相關統計以來，首次有颱風登陸茨城縣。
【啟明資訊：公司目前暫無紅旗H7車型前裝配套的汽車電子產品】啟明資訊(002232)8月12日在互動平臺表示，公司目前暫無紅旗H7車型前裝配套的汽車電子產品，主要為整車製造廠提供管理軟體、電子檢測服務、數字化工廠運維等產品及服務。紅旗H7車型作為公司客戶近期推出的新品，其銷量對公司業績可能產生非線性的拉動效果，具體影響程度受多種因素制約，難以量化，具有不確定性。

【蔡崇信支援的藍池資本旗下新基金首輪募資3億美元 將押注對沖基金策略】知情人士稱，阿里巴巴集團主席蔡崇信支援的藍池資本（Blue Pool Capital）旗下新基金7月完成首輪募資，籌得3億美元，資金將用於投資對沖基金策略。知情人士稱，這隻新基金是Harborside系列的第二隻基金，目標是在年底前完成5億美元募資，投資者包括超高淨值個人和機構。

Asian Stocks Mostly Rise — Asian equity markets mostly advanced on Wednesday, led by a more than 4% surge in South Korea’s KOSPI Composite Index as SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics rallied following reports that Singaporean state-owned investment firm Temasek Holdings plans to acquire stakes in the two companies. Sentiment was further supported by upbeat outlooks from CoreWeave and Super Micro Computer, as both companies continue to benefit from the ongoing artificial intelligence spending boom. Technology-heavy benchmarks in Japan and China also climbed, while shares in Australia and Hong Kong lagged. On the geopolitical front, investors assessed the prospects of a US-Iran deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz after Pakistan’s defense minister said Washington and Tehran are “close to some sort of arrangement.”
Financial Times reports Boston Fed President Collins would support a September rate hike if inf remains elevated.

【美團在泰州成立新科技公司，註冊資本300萬美元】天眼查App顯示，8月10日，泰州海騎科技有限公司成立，法定代表人為孫可青，註冊資本300萬美元，企業型別為有限責任公司（港澳臺法人獨資）。公司經營範圍含軟體開發、網路與資訊保安軟體開發、共享腳踏車服務、電動腳踏車銷售等，註冊地址位於江蘇省泰州市姜堰區。股東資訊顯示，該公司由Xigua Limited全資持股，認繳出資300萬美元。據公開資訊，Xigua Limited為美團旗下公司。

TAIEX Stays Near 4-Week High on Tech Sector Boost — The TAIEX, Taiwan’s benchmark stock index, climbed 343 points, or 0.8%, to 45,464 around noon on Wednesday, extending gains for the third consecutive session, mainly buoyed by electronic technology and producer manufacturing. The broader index lingered at its highest level since July 16, as traders capitalized on the upward momentum in the tech sector. Electronic technology stocks rose 1.0%, with TSMC, the world's largest contract chipmaker and a company that accounts for more than 40% of the market's total value, rising 0.4% after a 0.6% gain a day earlier. Delta Electronics gained 0.6%, while Hon Hai Precision Industry surged 2.5%. Yageo Corp., the world's third-largest multilayer ceramic capacitor (MLCC) maker, rose 0.3%. However, a decline on Wall Street overnight limited gains, as rising oil prices raised questions about the Fed's monetary policy at its upcoming meeting, while traders awaited the release of US inflation data later today.

【機構：光學在AI基礎設施中日益重要】盛寶金融首席投資策略師Charu Chanana表示，光學正成為AI基礎設施中日益重要的一部分。她在一份研究報告中稱，隨著AI叢集的增長，更多資料需要在GPU、伺服器、機架和資料中心之間快速高效地移動。她表示，光學互連利用光傳輸資料，可以提供AI網路擴充套件時日益需要的高頻寬和高能效。行業主要參與者包括中國的中際旭創和成都新易盛通訊技術，以及美國的Lumentum和高意。
【長江支流滁河發生今年第1號洪水】受降雨影響，今天10時25分，長江下游支流滁河曉橋水文站水位漲至警戒水位，依據主要江河洪水編號規定，此次洪水編號為“滁河2026年第1號洪水”。水利部已提前啟動針對江蘇、安徽的洪水防禦Ⅳ級應急響應，目前，水利部工作組正在安徽省颱風暴雨洪水防禦一線協助指導。

【Rumors Temasek to invest in SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics lift shares intraday】Shares of South Korean chipmakers jumped after Asia Business Daily reported Temasek is planning equity investments in Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix; both rallied more than 8% intraday and the KOSPI rose about 5%. The report said Temasek Holdings is weighing timing and intends to invest directly via its in‑house investment team. The names were sharply sold in July amid doubts over the pace of AI infrastructure build-out and deleveraging of leveraged positions; they have recently recovered as market attention shifts to planned shareholder-return measures.

【交易員：印度央行在外匯市場拋售美元以支撐印度盧比】據知情的交易員透露，由於面臨油價高企帶來的壓力，印度央行在在岸外匯市場拋售美元以支撐印度盧比。這些交易員因無權公開發言而要求匿名。美元兌印度盧比基本持平，報95.4037。注：受油價上漲影響，週三多數亞幣走低。受霍爾木茲海峽重開前景持續不明朗影響，布倫特原油價格上漲逾1%，報每桶90美元左右，連續第六個交易日走高。由於印度是原油的大進口國，高油價推高了該國的貿易逆差並加劇了通脹。過去幾周，印度央行一直定期在外匯市場進行干預，近期美元存款計劃帶來的資金流入推高了該行的外匯儲備。

【日本自動駕駛初創公司Turing計劃設立美國辦事處 目標IPO估值100億美元】日本自動駕駛初創公司Turing的執行長表示，該公司正尋求進入美國市場，並可能在未來五年內在美國上市，屆時公司估值將達到約100億美元。Turing執行長Issei Yamamoto表示，這家總部位於東京的公司計劃在明年內設立一個美國辦事處，最初將專注於資料收集和研發。Issei Yamamoto表示，美國是該公司在日本之後的下一個主要目標市場，他指出日本汽車製造商在美國市場佔有很大份額。Turing已與汽車製造商斯巴魯(Subaru)和汽車零部件供應商Denso建立了自動駕駛聯合研究夥伴關係，這兩家公司在美國和其他海外市場都有業務。Denso也是Turing的投資者。

【摩根大通上調新加坡股市目標位，經濟增長保持韌性】摩根大通上調新加坡股市目標，強勁的經濟增長以及與發達市場同類資產估值差距收窄，支撐市場前景。包括Khoi Vu在內的分析師在研報中表示，樂觀情景下，海峽時報指數未來 12 個月有望攀升至 7000 點。該目標較週二收盤點位存在 22% 的上行空間。摩根大通分析師稱：“溫和向好的經濟環境將持續支撐每股收益增長，並釋放財政空間。高收益率、匯率穩定以及股市發展計劃，將助力吸引資金流入。”受地緣衝突避險需求以及人工智慧引發的市場波動推動，新加坡股市今年走勢強勁。2026 年該基準指數漲幅超 23%。
【廣東揭陽揭西縣發生人員跳橋突發事件 2人死亡】8月11日，廣東揭陽市揭西縣河婆街道辦事處對外通報，2026年8月11日16時許，揭西縣河婆街道轄區發生一起人員跳橋突發事件。接報後，當地立即組織應急救援力量趕赴現場開展救援工作。目前，涉溺水2名人員（均為男性，河婆人）遺體已被搜救打撈上岸，無生命跡象。（央視）

Rupee Extends Losses Amid Oil Surge — The Indian rupee hovered around 95.4 per dollar, remaining under pressure as rising oil prices and weaker Asian currencies weighed on sentiment. The rupee has extended losses for another session since breaking past the 95 per dollar level last Wednesday, as uncertainty over the end of the US-Iran conflict has driven oil prices higher. Brent crude has risen 7% this week and was approaching $90 a barrel, prompting importers to step up hedging and increasing dollar demand, which has offset positive sentiment from RBI interventions. The central bank has been selling dollars through state-run banks in both trading sessions this week, with traders saying the rupee would likely have weakened further without the support. Meanwhile, US inflation data due later Wednesday could provide clues on whether the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates next month, with markets currently split on the prospect of a hike.

【訊息人士：印度塔塔之子公司董事長或因與塔塔信託基金關係緊張而提前辭職】據一位直接瞭解此事的訊息人士透露，印度塔塔之子公司（Tata Sons）——這家市值4000億美元的塔塔集團（Tata Group）的主要投資控股公司——的董事長正考慮辭職，原因在於與其最大股東關係緊張。該集團的慈善機構塔塔信託（Tata Trusts）持有塔塔之子公司約66%的股份，後者控制著30多家集團公司，包括塔塔諮詢服務公司、塔塔汽車公司和印度航空。雙方在董事會席位分配、戰略規劃以及少數股東沙普爾吉·帕隆吉（Shapoorji Pallonji）計劃退出等事宜上發生衝突，這一糾紛導致一名塔塔之子公司董事被罷免。一位因問題敏感而拒絕透露姓名的訊息人士稱，儘管董事長錢德拉塞卡蘭（N. Chandrasekaran）正在考慮辭職，但尚未做出最終決定。印度《經濟時報》週三報道稱，錢德拉塞卡蘭已與親信討論了辭職的可能性，此舉是在8月18日年度股東大會之前進行的，屆時塔塔之子公司的股東將就其連任進行投票。

【我國主導的生命科學領域國際學術期刊《Vita》紙質刊首期釋出】今天，我國主導的生命科學領域《Vita》系列期刊紙質刊首期釋出。“Vita”一詞源自拉丁語，中文為“生命”之意。《Vita》系列期刊由主刊《Vita》和系列子刊組成，依託“生命科學開放聯盟”相關高校和機構共同建設。生命科學開放聯盟由內地與港澳15家高水平高校和科研機構共同發起，於2025年8月12日在香港正式成立，目前由39所內地與港澳高校和機構共同組成，聯盟將高水平科技期刊、國際化科研資料開放平臺等作為重要的建設內容。《Vita》系列期刊採用“主刊+子刊”的辦刊模式，學術水平上對標三大國際頂刊及其子刊，打造我國生命科學領域自主一流期刊系列。該期刊將創新建立“以文評刊”的科學評價體系，透過對各刊所載原創論文學術水平的鑑定來評估期刊學術水平，擺脫對SCI等引證指標的片面依賴，引導期刊迴歸學術本質，推動營造良好學術生態。（央視新聞）

【Ukraine strikes Russian refinery; Russia imports gasoline from India for first time】Russia has started importing gasoline from India after Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries caused severe domestic fuel shortages, shipping data firm Kpler said. Kpler flagged this as Russia’s first import of automotive gasoline from a South Asian country: the initial India-origin cargo arrived on Aug. 5, and more shipments may follow. The fuel was carried on tankers linked to Russia and was transshipped near Egypt before moving to Russia. Kpler chief analyst Sumit Ritolia said Indian supplies, together with continued imports from Belarus and other nearby markets, underline the severity of Russia’s domestic gasoline supply-demand imbalance and reflect refinery run-rate cuts reshaping its refined-products trade flows.

Bangladesh Inflation Rate at 8-Month Low — The annual inflation rate in Bangladesh rose to 8.32% in July 2026, easing from 9.16% in the previous month. This reading marked the lowest level since November 2025, as inflation slowed the most in food and non-alcoholic beverages (7.16% vs 8.60% in June), transport (9.34% vs 10.10%), housing and utilities (9.48% vs 9.63%), health (3.90% vs 4.28%), communication (6.90% vs 9.76%), recreation and culture (8.80% vs 9.80%), and education (8.73% vs 9.11%). Meanwhile, inflation remained elevated for restaurants and hotels (12.57% vs 11.70%), clothing and footwear (9.75% vs 9.64%), and furnishings, household equipment, and routine household maintenance (6.58% vs 6.43%). On a monthly basis, consumer prices rose 1.44%, accelerating from 0.34% in June and marking the strongest monthly gain since October 2025. Bangladesh remains among the countries most vulnerable to disruptions related to the Middle East conflict due to its heavy reliance on imported fuel and limited reserve supplies.

【超純應材首日漲662%新晉四川股王   比亞迪潛伏2年大賺18.6億成贏家】8月11日，新股超純應材在深交所創業板掛牌交易。上市首日，公司盤中一度大漲7.4倍，最終收報503元/股，漲幅為662.24%。幸運中籤者中一簽該股可賺21.85萬元，是妥妥的“大肉籤”。超純應材上市首日的亮眼表現，讓其超過新易盛，躍升為四川新股王。超純應材造富效應也很強。作為創始人、實際控制人，柴傑、柴林兄弟合計持有公司47.98%股權，二人持股財富達到245.80億元。知名公司比亞迪也飽嘗了本次IPO盛宴。攜資近億元潛伏2年，加上本次IPO戰略配售，比亞迪合計斥資1.269億元入股，如今浮盈18.60億元，收益率高達14.66倍。（長江商報）

【蘇州：新就業群體颱風中受傷最高可獲10000元救助】據“蘇州釋出”，近日，受颱風“白海豚”影響，戶外勞動者作業風險攀升，部分新就業群體在工作過程中不慎發生摔傷、骨折等意外事故。蘇州市依託“新就業群體困難物件急難救助”基金，專門針對本次颱風災害開通專項救助通道，覆蓋快遞員、網約配送員、貨車司機、網約車司機等新就業群體，申請物件為在“白海豚”颱風期間在崗上線接單的新就業群體。從業者在工作時間內因颱風原因受傷或家庭經濟困難的，每戶可一次性獲5000-10000元救助金。

【東方證券：供給擴容、合規出清 醫美龍頭機構受益】東方證券釋出研報稱，醫美三類械注射產品審批提速，合規材料供給已較2020年顯著豐富。監管、流量平臺稽核和稅收規範共同壓縮“小、散、亂”機構依靠違規材料、低價獲客的空間，頭部機構憑藉牌照、醫生、品牌、集中採購及資訊化體系，有望承接被出清機構的客戶和醫生資源，推動市場份額提升。隨著醫美行業上游材料供給不斷增加，醫美機構話語權提升;同時隨著監管政策持續推進，加速市場份額向頭部企業集中，利好頭部合規醫美機構企業。

【Bessent-Takaichi split over BOJ policy could undermine yen rebound】Analysts say a fundamental split between US Treasury Secretary Bessent and Japanese Prime Minister Takaichi on Bank of Japan policy could weaken recent US-Japan efforts to push the yen higher. Over the past year Bessent has signalled tighter monetary policy is crucial to addressing yen weakness; Takaichi has warned rapid, large rate increases could derail Japan's recovery. Since Takaichi took office in October the BOJ has hiked twice but the policy rate remains low at 1%. Last month the US carried out its first yen intervention since 1998 while the BOJ stood pat — a mixed policy signal that contrasts with historical experience that reshaping market expectations typically requires sustained, forceful action. Peter Vassallo, portfolio manager at BNP Paribas Asset Management US, called the episode a "golden opportunity" missed.

【瑞銀財富管理：即將公佈的業績料為中國大型網際網路公司重估帶來動力】瑞銀財富管理投資總監辦公室發表機構觀點稱，中國市場的機會正日益擴大且更為均衡，科技板塊半導體裝置仍是首選，即將公佈的第二季度業績有望為大型網際網路公司的重估帶來動力。觀點稱，亞洲市場的板塊輪動日趨明顯，先前表現落後的市場（如MSCI中國指數）大幅跑贏東亞其他市場，上漲範圍擴大的趨勢有望延續。各行業盈利逐漸回穩，AI的結構性增長邏輯未變，國產化程序及國內超大規模雲服務商的需求，繼續支援中國本土硬體供應鏈。即將公佈的財報有望為中國網際網路板塊提供更清晰的訊號，比如雲業務增長是否加速、AI變現進展，以及核心業務的利潤率走勢等。股票回購持續、潛在的AI資產分拆以及監管環境趨穩，也應為網際網路板塊的重估增添助力。科技之外，也看好電力及醫療保健板塊；市況波動下，銀行、保險、精選的公用事業和日常消費板塊具備防禦性的現金流和收益。

【浙江：到2027年，腦機介面未來產業營收超過50億元】8月12日，浙江省人民政府辦公廳印發關於推進腦機介面產學研聯動的若干措施的通知。通知要求，聚焦腦機介面領域科技創新和產業創新深度融合，以醫療、消費、工業等重大應用場景建設為牽引，貫穿協同攻關、成果轉化、推廣應用、產業培育全鏈條，構建產業共培、資源統籌、風險共擔、利益共享的產學研聯動機制，建設腦機介面一流創新生態。到2027年，企業主導的產學研聯動機制有效執行，腦機介面核心軟硬體自主創新能力大幅提升，研發5個以上代表性產品並率先實現驗證應用，腦機介面未來產業營收超過50億元。到2030年，產學研聯動機制高效執行，腦機介面領域科技創新和產業創新深度融合，形成一批典型應用場景和商業化應用產品，培育一批科技領軍企業，建成具有較強國際競爭力的腦機介面技術和產業創新高地。

【AI optimism fuels chip rally; South Korea market gains for third day】South Korean stocks rose on Wednesday for a third straight session, led by a surge in chip shares on AI optimism; the KOSPI climbed more than 4% to 6,635 points, its highest level since Aug. 5. Kiwoom Securities analyst Han Ji-young said validation of strong AI infrastructure demand from CoreWeave and Supermicro should boost flows into the semiconductor sector and domestic AI-related names. Heavyweights Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix jumped over 7%; LG Energy Solution rose about 3%; Hyundai Motor and Kia gained roughly 2% and 1.5%, respectively.

【Societe Generale: AI CapEx to accelerate in H2, peak could be H1 2027】Societe Generale strategist Manish Kabra’s team says recent extreme swings in semiconductors and momentum trades reflect concentrated de-leveraging and hedge fund unwind, not a synchronous weakening of AI fundamentals. They assess South Korea’s most acute de-leveraging phase is nearing an end and US momentum strategies have seen large-scale reductions. Hyperscaler cloud businesses remain in a strong upcycle in the latest results cycle; order backlogs are up about 15% and have pushed AI capital spending roughly 10% higher. The team expects AI CapEx to continue accelerating into H2 2026, with a potential peak in H1 2027. Societe Generale advises distinguishing trading-driven de-leveraging—which has cooled—from the still-expanding industrial CapEx cycle; until hyperscaler free cash flow materially improves, hardware, infrastructure and supply-chain suppliers that directly capture AI CapEx are likely more direct beneficiaries than high-spend customers.

【曝小紅書打造全新“AI導購”功能，官方暫無回應】今日有訊息稱，小紅書在打造全新的“AI導購”功能，依託對話互動模式，在問答場景中直接推送商品卡片、掛載下單跳轉連結，該專案由道玄（潘博遠）主導推進。對此訊息，向小紅書官方進行求證，截至發稿暫無回應。（新浪科技）

Palm Oil Retreats on Ample Supplies, Profit-Taking — Malaysian palm oil futures eased, slipping below MYR 4,720 per tonne as profit-taking set in after a two-week high. Losses tracked declines in edible oils on the Dalian exchange and were compounded by signs of ample supply: July inventories rose 3.32% to 2.63 million tonnes, while output surged 9.41% to 1.79 million tonnes. Softer Chinese inflation data underscored weak demand in the world’s top edible oil importer, further weighing on sentiment. Still, downside was cushioned by a weaker ringgit and firmer soyoil prices on the Chicago exchange. In top buyer India, festive-season demand expectations lent support after July imports hit a ten-month peak. Export prospects brightened as cargo surveyors estimated shipments rose between 2.6% and 14.8% in the first ten days of August. Meanwhile, stronger crude oil prices added a tailwind, with Middle East supply concerns, heightened by attacks on two ships and uncertainty over a U.S.–Iran peace deal, bolstering the broader commodity complex.

STI Pulls Back from Record High on Profit-Taking — Singapore's stocks fell 36 points, or 0.6%, to 5,718 in Wednesday morning trade, erasing gains from the previous three sessions, as traders took profits after the index hit a record high a day earlier. The STI closed at 5,754 on Tuesday, buoyed by strong economic data following an upward revision to Q2 GDP growth to 5.9%. The broader index tracked a decline on Wall Street overnight, as rising oil prices raised concerns over inflation and expectations of an interest rate hike. Traders were cautious ahead of the release of US inflation data later today for clues about the Fed's monetary policy decisions at its upcoming meeting. However, fresh data capped the fall, as Singapore's current account surplus widened in Q2 from the same period in 2025. Communication, technology services, and finance mainly weighed on the index, with the biggest laggards being Jardine Matheson Holdings (-2.2%), Jardine Cycle & Carriage (-1.0%), OCBC (-0.9%), and Hongkong Land Holdings (-0.8%).

【印尼龍船隻起火114人全部安全撤離】據印尼救援部門訊息，當地時間8月12日，一艘船隻在印尼龍目海峽航行過程中發生火災。事故發生後，救援人員迅速展開處置，船上114人已全部安全撤離。救援部門表示，目前暫無人員傷亡報告。火災原因仍在調查中。

【South Korea 30-year government bond yield hits record high as oil rises, insurer demand weakens】South Korea's 30-year government bond yield rose as high as 4.67% on Wednesday, the highest since the bond's 2012 launch, after rising oil prices tied to Middle East tensions and hawkish Bank of Korea commentary added pressure. A senior Bank of Korea official said semiconductor-led strong growth is lifting potential inflation and may require further rate hikes, weighing on ultra-long bond demand. Demand from life insurers — a key buyer of super-long paper — has eased after regulatory changes reduced the urgency to lengthen asset duration, cutting their purchases of ultra-long maturities.

【浙江：鼓勵腦機介面企業自主合理定價 開通醫用耗材掛網“綠色通道”】浙江省人民政府辦公廳印發《關於推進腦機介面產學研聯動的若干措施》的通知。其中提到，最佳化產品應用路徑。制定腦機介面產品醫療應用清單，根據產品獲批上市情況動態更新。鼓勵腦機介面企業自主合理定價，開通醫用耗材掛網“綠色通道”，在申報後10個工作日內辦結。鼓勵醫療機構根據臨床需要，按照“應配盡配”原則配備使用列入醫療應用清單的腦機介面產品，或設立臨時採購綠色通道。試點開展腦機介面創新醫療器械示範推廣應用專案，推動重點產品和典型場景申報國家高階醫療裝備推廣應用專案。

Japan 10-Year Yield Gains on Higher Oil Prices — Japan’s 10-year government bond yield rose to around 2.84% on Wednesday, reaching a one-week high as stronger oil prices intensified inflation concerns and bolstered expectations for a more aggressive policy tightening cycle from the Bank of Japan. Oil prices advanced amid renewed uncertainty in the Middle East, although Pakistan’s defense minister said Washington and Tehran are “close to some sort of arrangement.” Meanwhile, investors are assessing the likelihood of a BOJ rate hike in September after an increasing number of policymakers called for a stronger response to mounting inflation pressures. The central bank also faces persistent yen weakness, which has amplified the impact of higher oil prices and kept import costs elevated.

【Zhejiang to bolster lifecycle finance for brain–computer interface firms, encourage appropriate listing routes】Zhejiang provincial government office issued measures to advance industry‑academia‑research linkage for brain–computer interfaces (BCI), directing provincial 4+1 special fund and the Zhejiang social‑security sci‑tech innovation fund to market‑oriented support for promising BCI companies and R&D pipelines. The measures steer social capital toward earlier, smaller, longer‑term and hard‑tech investments; eligible BCI projects will be admitted to the provincial government investment fund project library and can access the private‑enterprise industrial‑fund equity‑financing direct‑access channel. Financial institutions are urged to develop proof‑of‑concept, pilot‑scale and technology‑commercialization loan products, support IP‑pledge financing and securitization, and strengthen full‑lifecycle financing; the province will also promote eligible BCI firms to choose suitable listing routes.

【浙江：強化腦機介面企業全生命週期金融支援 推動腦機介面企業選擇合適上市方式】浙江省人民政府辦公廳印發《關於推進腦機介面產學研聯動的若干措施》的通知。其中提到，強化金融支援。發揮省“4+1”專項基金、浙江社保科創基金作用，以市場化方式積極支援有潛力的腦機介面企業和優質研發管線專案，引導社會資本投早、投小、投長期、投硬科技。用好“民營企業申請產業基金股權融資直通車”，符合條件的腦機介面專案納入省級政府投資基金專案庫。引導金融機構創新“概念驗證貸”“中試貸”“科技成果轉化貸”等金融產品，支援腦機介面智慧財產權質押融資與證券化，強化腦機介面企業全生命週期金融支援。推動符合條件的腦機介面企業選擇合適上市方式。

【浙江：建立腦機介面醫療器械產品研發清單 加快產品上市程序】浙江省人民政府辦公廳印發《關於推進腦機介面產學研聯動的若干措施》的通知。其中提到，支援開展臨床研究。結合臨床資源優勢、規範管理能力等，分類建設腦機介面臨床試驗基地、臨床與轉化病房、臨床預備佇列，對僅用於臨床研究的床位，不納入病床效益、週轉率、使用率、疾病診斷相關分組（DRGs）臨床績效等考核評價體系。推動審評審批改革。對進入國家創新醫療器械特別審查程式的腦機介面產品，落實專人專班輔導。建立腦機介面醫療器械產品研發清單，開展“提前介入、研審聯動”服務，加快產品上市程序。支援臨床價值明確、創新性強的腦機介面第二類醫療器械進入特別審查程式，審評時限壓縮至40個工作日以內。對臨床急需的腦機介面醫療器械開設優先檢驗綠色通道，在註冊檢驗、核查檢查等方面實行“即到即辦”。

【Yen option activity rises ahead of US CPI as traders hedge intervention risk, buy longer-dated USD/JPY calls】One-week USD/JPY option implied volatility rose for a second session on Wednesday after five days of declines as traders ramp up option activity ahead of the US CPI print. Market participants are using derivatives to position around an inflation read that could alter Fed policy and dollar direction. Short-dated vol and a premium in USD/JPY puts over calls show demand for protection amid lingering fears of coordinated US-Japan FX intervention and sudden dollar weakness; longer-dated vol has also ticked up as investors buy calls to bet on a later USD/JPY rebound.
【中國海軍第49批護航編隊起航赴亞丁灣】中國海軍第49批護航編隊12日上午從海南三亞某軍港解纜起航，赴亞丁灣、索馬利亞海域接替第48批護航編隊執行護航任務。第49批護航編隊主要由南部戰區海軍兵力組成，包括導彈驅逐艦昆明艦、導彈護衛艦岳陽艦和大型遠洋綜合補給艦駱馬湖艦，攜帶艦載直升機2架、特戰隊員數十名。3艘軍艦均由我國自主設計建造，其中，昆明艦為首次執行護航任務。(新華社)

【Fan Gang: China property market showing relatively rapid price clearing】Economist Fan Gang said China’s property market has entered a relatively rapid price-clearing phase and the bottoming process could be faster than Japan’s at the time. He said China is undergoing a more market-driven structural adjustment as long-standing supply-heavy, weak-demand imbalances start to correct. The 15th Five-Year Plan now treats market demand as the scarcest resource, and consumption patterns are shifting: younger, tech-affluent buyers increasingly prioritise housing quality, with luxury homes in major cities becoming a sales driver—signalling a move toward a more market-oriented growth dynamic.

【中信建投：二季度煤價同比上漲 部分割槽域月度電價回升】中信建投釋出研報稱，火電方面，2026年第2季度，動力煤市場價同比上漲，廣東、江蘇等區域受電力供需偏緊、一次能源價格抬升等因素的影響，月度交易電價有所回升，部分對沖燃料成本的上升。同時，考慮到年度長協電量佔比較高，儘管月度電價回升，該行預期火電26Q2~Q3業績仍可能承壓。綠電方面，受新能源消納壓力較大疊加136號文推動新能源全面入市影響，2026上半年業績及估值均承壓。電力供需方面，受火電機組核准及投產節奏的影響，2027年全國火電新增裝機增速有望放緩，疊加一次能源價格的回升，27年長協電價有望企穩回升。綜合而言，電力板塊二季度業績壓力較大，江浙等用電增速較高區域的火電經營情況有望逐步改善。

【Henan issues list of priority areas for government investment funds】Henan provincial development and reform commission said on Aug. 11 that, with provincial government approval, it has issued a list designating 78 sub-sectors across four pillars—emerging pillar industries, future industries, traditional advantaged industries and modern services—as priority targets for government investment funds. The future industries category covers six areas: artificial and embodied intelligence, hydrogen energy, bio-manufacturing, quantum technologies, next-generation information networks and brain-like intelligence/brain–computer interfaces, and specifically highlights investment in humanoid robots, general-purpose large models, full-chain hydrogen technologies, bio-breeding, quantum computing and 6G mobile communications.

【US Forces CV-22 Osprey makes emergency landing in Tochigi】A CV-22 Osprey from US Forces Japan's Yokota Air Base made a precautionary emergency landing at the Japan Ground Self-Defense Force Utsunomiya Airfield in Tochigi prefecture at about 15:00 local time on the 10th. Japan's Defense Ministry notified local governments by the 12th. The US said the landing was a "precautionary landing" to avoid an accident; the aircraft departed the airfield on the 11th. No injuries or damage have been confirmed. The Defense Ministry has not released the flight route or the cause of the landing.

【阿里雲：靈駿真武M890超節點例項上線，可承載十萬億引數模型 】阿里雲宣佈靈駿真武 M890超節點例項上線，首批已在烏蘭察布地域開售。企業級客戶無需自建機房，在雲上即可開通64卡高速互聯算力單元，最高可承載十萬億引數級MoE大模型推理。據悉，阿里雲靈駿真武M890超節點是國內首個成功執行超2萬億引數大模型的超節點形態算力，Kimi K3和Qwen3.8 Max均已透過該例項對外提供服務。超節點例項支援FP8/FP4低精度計算，透過 ICN Switch 1.0晶片Scale-up互聯規模由 16卡拉昇至 64卡，卡間互聯提升至 800GB/s。在智慧駕駛、具身智慧等訓練場景中，相比上一代真武810E，訓練效能提升三倍。支撐該超節點叢集的是阿里雲統一底座——靈駿智算平臺。依託HPN 8.0訓推一體網路，單叢集最高支援 13 萬卡異構算力混布，並可擴充套件至百萬卡級。（新浪科技）

US 10-Year Yield Edges Lower — The yield on the US 10-year Treasury note eased to around 4.68% on Wednesday, extending its decline into a second session as investors positioned ahead of key inflation data that could provide fresh guidance on the Federal Reserve’s policy outlook. The consumer price index is due later today, with producer inflation figures scheduled for Thursday. Markets remain split over the prospect of a 25-basis-point Fed rate hike in September after the central bank left rates unchanged in July, while firmer oil prices continue to bolster expectations for a hawkish stance. On Tuesday, Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee said policymakers remain more focused on the risk of persistently elevated inflation than potential weakness in the labor market. Meanwhile, investors continued to monitor prospects for a US-Iran agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz after Pakistan’s defense minister said Washington and Tehran are “close to some sort of arrangement.”

【咖哩豬排指數顯示日元嚴重低估 建立人稱比大麥克指數更貼切】隨著當局干預匯市的影響正在消退，紐約梅隆銀行高階策略師Geoff Yu利用日本一道快餐主食的價格，以準確衡量日元的疲軟程度。Yu建立了咖哩豬排指數，作為《經濟學人》大麥克指數(Big Mac Index)的替代指標。他認為，相較於大麥克這種漢堡，比較咖哩豬排飯的國際價格，更能反映日元貶值對日本民眾究竟是什麼感受。週三上午的全球外匯市場上，1美元約兌159.23日元。但根據Yu的計算，在考量咖哩餐點價格反映的日元購買力後，1美元應該只能兌62.18日元。這意味著，外匯市場正大幅低估日元。相較之下，基於麥當勞漢堡各國價格的大麥克指數顯示，1美元應該可以兌換80.30日元。Yu說，如果目標是讓購買力向高收入國家看齊，這項指數顯示，日元需要更為強勁。他採用全球最大咖哩飯連鎖店CoCo壹番屋的價格計算，該公司在全球擁有約1500家分店。

Indonesia Stocks Rebound — Indonesian shares rose 51 points or 0.8% to 6,319 in early deals on Wednesday, halting losses in the prior two sessions amid widespread gains across major sectors led by infrastructure, energy, basic materials, and cyclicals. sentiment improved following fresh data showing July car sales surged 33%, hinting at recovery in the automotive sector. Traders also took note of President Prabowo’s nomination of acting BI Governor Destry Damayanti as the sole candidate to succeed Perry Warjiyo, a move seen as providing policy continuity. Still, upside was tempered by overnight weakness on Wall Street and caution ahead of MSCI’s August 2026 Review later today, with rebalancing effective after August 31. Domestic concerns also lingered as retail sales fell for a third straight month in June, weighed by softness in discretionary categories. Standout movers included Indosat (8.4%), Petrindo Jaya Kreasi (5.6%), Bumi Resources (2.8%), and Japfa Comfeed (1.8%).

【Alibaba Cloud launches Lingjun Zhenwu M890 super-node instance; first batch on sale in Ulanqab】Alibaba Cloud has launched the Lingjun Zhenwu M890 super-node instance, with the first batch now on sale in the Ulanqab region. It is the first domestic super-node configuration reported to run models exceeding 2 trillion parameters; Kimi K3 and Qwen3.8 Max are available via the instance. Technical features include FP8/FP4 low-precision compute support and an ICN Switch 1.0 scale-up interconnect that raises node scale from 16 to 64 cards and boosts inter-card bandwidth to 800 GB/s. Alibaba Cloud reports training performance is roughly three times that of the previous-generation Zhenwu 810E in autonomous driving and embodied-intelligence training scenarios.

【中鎢線上：鎢價漲跌兩難 鎢市買賣不旺】據中鎢線上公眾號，8月12日，國內鎢市場延續僵持橫盤格局。近期交投活躍度有所回升，但尚未形成規模性支撐，價格驅動力不足，成交仍以商談為主，整體按需進行。鎢精礦市場上，礦商挺價意願較強，場內低價貨源難覓，55%以上品位鎢精礦價格穩固在41萬元/標噸上方，市場流動性相對侷限。仲鎢酸銨（APT）市場上，在成本支撐與需求承壓的交織下多空博弈，成交重心持續僵持在60萬元/噸關口附近。鎢粉末市場上，買賣雙方保持觀望拉鋸態勢，市場訂單有所增量，但議價水平仍有承壓，鎢粉交易重心在950元/公斤左右，碳化鎢粉議價在880元/公斤左右。鎢鐵市場上，產業鏈上下游僵持背景下，交投主動性不足，行情維持橫盤觀望，70鎢鐵報價暫穩在66萬元/噸左右。鎢廢料市場上，持貨商惜售探高，但消費端與回收商接受度有限，市場漲跌兩難，行情維持窄幅震盪整理。

【India to tighten NGO oversight, may empower seizure of foreign-funded NGO assets】India plans to tighten regulation of NGOs, including a proposed amendment that would empower a new agency to seize land, buildings or other assets owned by foreign-funded organizations whose mandatory official registration is cancelled or not renewed. The ruling Modi-led Hindu nationalist government is prepared to push the reforms despite lobbying from Western governments, opposition parties and Christian churches warning the move could jeopardize thousands of schools, hospitals, religious sites and humanitarian projects. A senior Indian official said the government may seek a parliamentary vote on the amendment before this Thursday’s session ends. Officials cite concerns about covert foreign influence as the rationale for the tighter oversight.

【ANTHROPIC to embed invisible watermark in Claude outputs】ANTHROPIC said on Aug 11 it has signed the EU AI Act Article 50 guidelines on AI-generated content transparency. Effective Aug 2, Claude models will embed an invisible watermark in generated text; images and other files will carry digitally signed provenance metadata. The marking will cover all major Claude products and access channels — Claude Platform (API), Claude, Claude Code, Claude Cowork and Claude Tag — and apply to cloud partners including AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft Foundry. New Zealand Dollar Edges Lower — The New Zealand dollar slipped to around $0.587 as the US dollar edged higher, with investors awaiting US inflation data for fresh clues on the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate path. A hotter-than-expected CPI reading could reinforce expectations for tighter US monetary policy, boosting the greenback. On the domestic front, markets remain set on a rate increase from the Reserve Bank of New Zealand in September after the central bank signalled that further tightening may be needed to remove monetary stimulus and keep inflation under control. However, last week’s soft jobs data has raised questions about how aggressively the RBNZ can continue raising rates. Meanwhile, uncertainty over the prospects for a Middle East peace deal that could reopen the Strait of Hormuz weighed on market confidence. In other news, NZ Prime Minister Christopher Luxon said that he survived a leadership vote among his own party’s lawmakers less than three months before an election.

【Chief Executive John Lee: Greater Bay Area a key entry point for Hong Kong to integrate with and serve national development】Chief Executive John Lee said on Aug. 11 this year is the opening year of the national '15th Five-Year Plan' and that the Guangdong–Hong Kong–Macao Greater Bay Area (GBA) is an important entry point for Hong Kong to integrate with and serve the national development agenda. The SAR government will use Hong Kong's 'one country, two systems' connectivity to support high-quality GBA development, assist mainland GBA and other provincial firms in expanding overseas, and attract international high-end talent and capital to boost growth. 【李家超：粵港澳大灣區是香港融入和服務國家發展大局的重要切入點】“今年是國家‘十五五’規劃的開局之年。粵港澳大灣區建設是香港融入和服務國家發展大局的重要切入點，特區政府將繼續發揮香港在‘一國兩制’下內聯外通的優勢，積極服務大灣區高質量建設，支援大灣區內地城市以至不同省市的企業‘走出去’，同時把國際高階人才與資金‘引進來’，為發展注入動能。”香港特區行政長官李家超11日說。特區政府就香港第一個五年規劃的公眾諮詢將於8月14日結束，計劃在下個月內公佈具體內容。李家超稱，香港主動對接國家發展戰略，以宏觀和前瞻的視角，勾勒香港未來五年的願景及目標，把握國家“十五五”規劃帶來的龐大機遇，推動香港更好融入和服務國家發展大局。（中新網）

【塔牌集團：當前水泥價格已處於階段性底部 再向下的機率很小】塔牌集團(002233)8月11日在電話會議中表示，因近期廣東地區雨水和颱風天氣較多，影響工程施工，導致需求疲軟，珠三角市場水泥價格在7月中旬推漲後又慢慢回落，粵東市場在7月中旬提價後價格相對穩定。當前價格已處於階段性底部，再向下的機率很小，一方面是煤價上漲推動成本壓力，另一方面行業大部分企業虧損嚴重，自救意願增強。下半年能否漲價，主要看9月後天氣好轉帶來的真實需求恢復，按批覆產能進行生產的執行力度以及行業錯峰生產自律意識能否加強。
【SpaceXAI推出“全天候數字同事”Grok Bot】SpaceXAI當地時間8月11日宣佈推出AI代理產品Grok Bot，目前處於測試階段。宣告稱，Grok Bot是一支全天候線上的智慧助手團隊，可接受並完成使用者分配給它們的實際工作任務。據介紹，Grok Bot擁有獨立的雲端計算機，可以登入使用者已經在用的工具，跨應用、收件箱等場景工作，任務完成後才返回彙報。

【天海防務：目前船舶行業整體處於較好的發展視窗】天海防務(300008)8月11日在機構調研中表示，船舶屬於週期性行業，週期波動客觀存在，很難精準預判行情能夠持續多久。從行業層面看，當前具備多重有利支撐：一是全球海事環保政策持續推進，新能源相關政策帶來行業發展機遇；二是行業進入換船週期，老舊船舶競爭力下降，帶動多用途船等船型更新需求，也是公司現階段訂單的重要來源；三是全球貿易格局多元化，貿易需求具備剛性，地緣政治不確定性也許會給航運及造船行業帶來一定的業務機會。綜合來看，目前行業整體處於較好的發展視窗，但行情持續時長、景氣高度難以做準確預測。

【南方電網公司謀劃實施進一步深化改革】近日，南方電網公司召開2026年年中工作會議，進一步深化改革工作要點（2026—2029年）及臺賬作為會議成果之一進行釋出。南方電網公司貫徹落實黨中央關於進一步深化國資國企改革的重大決策部署，聚焦破除體制機制障礙和高質量發展中的突出問題，深入研究提出7個方面、22條、123項改革任務舉措，已完成企業內部決策程式，即將正式印發實施。在“十五五”開局之年，南方電網公司新一輪國資國企改革就此拉開帷幕。圍繞構建與“三個新型”建設相適應的新型能源生產關係，提出健全適應新型能源體系的市場價格機制和管理體系、加快南方區域電力市場建設、構建多元主體涉網技術監督體系、加快建設主配微協同的新型電網平臺、建設權威互認的新型電力系統標準體系、加快“電碳算”協同發展和“六網”協同發展等。

Hong Kong Stocks Slip as Investors Turn Cautious — The Hang Seng Index slipped 1.0%, or 259 points, to 25,390 on Wednesday, as fading hopes for a US-Iran deal and caution ahead of the latest US inflation data weighed on investor sentiment. Oil prices climbed to a one-week high amid tensions surrounding the Strait of Hormuz, raising concerns over inflation and global growth. The decline also followed losses on Wall Street. In the region, Hong Kong technology stocks remained under pressure, with investors closely watching Tencent’s second-quarter earnings for signs of growth in gaming, advertising and AI investments. Meanwhile, plans to expand the Hang Seng Tech Index from 30 to 50 constituents could increase exposure to emerging sectors such as AI and robotics. Hong Kong’s IPO market also remained in focus, with Shein reportedly preparing to launch its Hong Kong IPO, supporting optimism over the city’s capital-market activity. Notable laggards included Tencent (-2.3%), AIA (-0.6%), Lenovo (-0.6%), Kuaishou (-1.6%), and Meituan (-2.3%).

Heating Oil Approaches 4-Month High — US heating oil futures advanced toward $4.30 per gallon on Wednesday, approaching a four-month high amid mounting concerns over tight distillate supplies. Yemen’s Houthis recently attacked Saudi Arabia’s Jazan refinery, which has been shut since July 27 following an earlier strike by the group. Plans to restart the facility have since been postponed from August 15 to August 30. Russia’s fuel export restrictions have also added to global supply concerns. This comes on top of uncertainty over the Strait of Hormuz, where markets are assessing the prospects for a potential US-Iran agreement on the key waterway. Pakistan’s defense minister said Washington and Tehran were “close to some sort of arrangement,” while a Qatari official cited by Al Jazeera said Iran-Oman talks had reached an advanced stage. Meanwhile, US refiners are processing crude at the highest seasonal pace since 2018, despite capacity falling by 600,000 barrels per day over the same period.

【最高法釋出7件特許經營典型案例 明確被特許人享有“冷靜期”單方解除權】今天，最高人民法院釋出7件關於特許經營的典型案例，引導和規範經營主體誠信合規經營，促進特許經營健康有序發展。其中一個特點是依法保障被特許人合法權益。在特許經營活動中，特許人與被特許人資訊不對稱、簽約能力不對等，被特許人處於相對弱勢地位，容易發生權利義務失衡。案例二中，雖然涉案合同未明確約定被特許人在特許經營合同訂立後一定期限內可以單方解除合同（俗稱“冷靜期”條款），但人民法院明確被特許人享有的“冷靜期”單方解除權屬於法定權利，被特許人可以在經營資源尚未被實際利用的合理期限內依法行使。案例五中，特許人在合同履行期間被撤銷備案資格，履約能力明顯弱化，人民法院依法支援了被特許人解除合同的訴請。(央視新聞)
